title: Market Analyst
description:
**About Modo Energy**
---------------------

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 90+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

**The Role**

We're hiring an Iberia Market Analyst to build Modo Energy's products for Spain and Portugal. Iberia is one of Europe's fastest-moving storage markets, and our customers rely on us to understand how batteries earn revenue there.

This is a builder's role. You'll design the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, build and ship benchmarks, and work with our European forecast team to shape the forecast product for both markets. You'll also help teach Ko, our AI analyst, to become the best source of answers on Iberia.

We're looking for a generalist. You should be as comfortable automating a data pipeline as explaining a market to a customer, and you should enjoy turning messy data into products people use.

Our coverage is battery energy storage, solar, wind and data centres, and we expect it to grow.

You'll be part of the Iberia team, reporting to the Iberia Regional Head and working closely with engineering and the European forecasting team.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and automate the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, from TSOs, NEMOs, and other sources.
* Build, maintain and ship Iberian benchmarks, working with engineering to deploy them to customers on the Modo Energy Terminal.
* Train Ko on Iberia: Improve how useful our AI model is to clients. Expose the right datasets, improve its answers, and deepen its market knowledge.
* Work with the European forecast team on the Spanish and Portuguese forecasts: fundamentals, market design, and how regulatory and market changes feed into the models.
* Maintain a grid-scale asset and capacity register for Spain and Portugal.
* Use AI to build tools and workflows that help you and the team scale.
* Contribute market insight through research and customer calls.

**What We're Looking For**

*The Essentials*

* You like building things, and you use AI to build tools and workflows.
* 2+ years of experience in power markets, energy analytics, data, or a technical analyst role.
* Strong programming skills. You can interrogate complex datasets and pick up new tools quickly.
* Familiarity with battery energy storage or wider energy transition themes.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable moving between data, product, and market questions.
* Clear written communication.
* Professional fluency in Spanish and English.
* You're comfortable building products for a region from the ground up.

*Nice To Have*

* Knowledge of Iberian electricity markets: OMIE day-ahead and intraday, REE balancing services (aFRR, mFRR, RR), and the capacity mechanism.
* Experience with data pipelines or workflow orchestration (e.g. Airflow, Dagster, dbt).
* Experience building data products or modelling tools, such as revenue models or dispatch optimisation.
* A working knowledge of Portuguese.

**Please note we can only consider candidates who already have the right to work in Spain, as we can't offer visa sponsorship at this time.**

**Equal Opportunity**

Modo Energy is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at careers@modoenergy.com.

**What You Can Expect From Us**
-------------------------------

At Modo Energy, we believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional reward. We're a high-performance team; ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely motivated by the scale of what we're trying to build.

You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. We're hybrid: everyone works Tuesday to Thursday in office, with Monday and Friday flexible. We offer top-of-market compensation, equity for every employee, and the space to take your career wherever you want it to go.

We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers. If that's you, we want to talk.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
**Lead engineering that powers how thousands of finance teams spend**
=====================================================================

Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform trusted by thousands of finance teams across Europe. As our **Head of Engineering**, you'll lead a complete engineering group — several Engineering Managers, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers — reporting directly to our CTO. You'll set the technical and organisational direction for your area, build the leadership team that runs it, and be accountable for the economics, reliability, and pace of everything it ships.

You will work with 2 to 4 Engineering Managers, reporting directly to you. You will collaborate with the Head of Product and the Head of Design, and other Head of Engineering responsible for other groups.

Your will be responsible for a multi-disciplinary engineering team of 20-30 people, with different seniority and skillset, spread across Europe.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Technical & organisational strategy**

* Define the multi-quarter technical and organisational strategy for your group, aligned with Spendesk's company strategy.
* Drive architectural decisions and simplification across your domain — clear domain boundaries, “platformisation”, debt reduction.
* Make build vs. buy vs. partner calls, and own your group's AI/tooling strategy: what to standardise, what to pilot, and how you measure impact.
* Own your area's economics — cost-to-serve, infra efficiency, hiring ROI — with a clear quarterly view, and present the commercial rationale behind your investment decisions.

**Delivery & operations**

* Be accountable for delivery and outcomes across your full portfolio of squads, balancing competing priorities without losing sight of quality.
* Establish group-level KPIs, SLOs, and operating rhythms so your teams run well without you in every room.
* Champion end-to-end observability, sensible on-call, and postmortems that actually change things — reducing incident frequency and MTTR over time.
* Sequence hiring and headcount to maximise impact, and defend that plan to stakeholders with data.

**Building your leadership team**

* Hire, develop, and retain a strong, balanced leadership team of EMs, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers.
* Coach your managers through their hardest calls: performance conversations, hiring decisions, prioritisation trade-offs.
* Lead performance calibration for your group and make the final call on promotions and compensation.
* Build succession plans for your key leadership roles, so no single departure puts your group at risk.
* Actively invest in retaining your best people, and keep a genuine pulse on team sentiment.

**Influence beyond your team**

* Represent Engineering in company-wide forums, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and customer-facing teams.
* Communicate your strategy and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and executives — you're as comfortable defending a roadmap to the leadership team as you are challenging an incident response plan.
* Champion diversity and inclusion in how you hire, develop, and run your organisation.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 8+ years in software engineering with increasing scope, including 3+ years managing managers (Team Leads/EMs).
* A track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder programmes in product-led SaaS on time, on budget, with measurable results. Fintech, payments, or compliance experience is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience operating distributed systems at scale in production, and enough technical depth to earn credibility with ICs and Team Leads, not just manage around them.
* Comfort with our stack (TypeScript, Node, React, AWS…). You don't need to write code daily, but you need to read it and question it.
* Real business acumen: you can talk unit economics, ROI, and trade-offs as fluently as you talk architecture.
* A genuine track record of growing managers into better managers, not just engineers into better engineers.

**Why this role, why now**
==========================

You'll join at a moment where the group you lead has room to simplify, room to invest in AI-augmented engineering, and a leadership team worth building further. You'll have a documented path behind you and ahead of you: Spendesk's Engineering Leadership Growth Journey maps the road from Engineering Manager through Head of Engineering to CTO, so you'll know exactly what's expected of you, and what growing further looks like once you're here.

You'll be based in one of our offices (Paris, London or Barcelona), with a flexible on-site rhythm agreed with your team.

As we are an international team, please submit your application and CV in English.

**About Spendesk**

Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform that transforms company spending. By simplifying procurement, payment cards, expense management, invoice processing, and accounting automation, Spendesk sets the new standard for spending at work. Its single, intelligent solution makes efficient spending easy for employees and gives finance leaders the full visibility and control they need across all company spend, even in multi-entity structures. Trusted by thousands of companies, Spendesk supports over 200,000 users across brands such as Payfit, Accor, Welcome to the Jungle, Swile, Big Mamma, Malt and Yousign. With offices in the United Kingdom, France, Spain and Germany, Spendesk also puts community at the heart of its mission.
  
  
For more information: www.spendesk.com/press  
  
**About our people & culture**

We believe that people do their best work when they’re given the freedom to thrive and grow. That’s why liberation is at the core of everything we do. We empower Spendeskers to take ownership of their work, to navigate ambiguity, and seize every opportunity. Spendeskers come from all over the world (35+ countries and counting!) but we have plenty in common: we're bold, ever-curious, committed to kindness, and tackle every challenge with a positive mindset.
  
  
**About our benefits**

Our culture is built on trust, empowerment, and growth — with benefits to match!

* Flexible on-site and remote policy
* Latest Apple equipment — the tools you need to excel
* Access to Moka.care — for emotional and mental health wellbeing
* Great office snacks — to fuel your day
* A positive team to work with daily!

We also offer location-specific benefits tailored to each market, including health insurance, wellness allowances, commuter support, meal vouchers, and gym memberships — ensuring you're well supported wherever you're based.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

At Spendesk, we're committed to fostering an environment where all differences are encouraged, supported and celebrated. We're building our culture for everyone, with everyone. Our goal is to attract and build a diverse, equal and inclusive team, where everyone feels welcome and we truly embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

* Book and brief freelance editors, motion designers, color and sound, and track every revision round

* You know how post-production works: edit, motion, color, sound and final deliveries
* You've handled campaigns with many versions of the same ad, and you don't lose track of which cut is the latest

* Fluent English and Spanish. Our clients work in English, and a lot of our team and suppliers work in Spanish
* You live in Barcelona. Shoots and part of the team are here

This is a freelance role at 2,500 EUR per month (plus VAT), invoiced as a freelancer or a company. We work with you full-time on our 4-day week, Monday to Thursday, with flexible hours and at least two days a week at our office in Poblenou.

At Camping, diverse teams drive better ideas and better work. We welcome collaborators from all backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, respectful environment for everyone we work with.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
##### **About our Crew**

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy. We spend each day surrounded by 500,000 boats from across the globe!

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

**How do we do it?**

At Click&Boat, we believe in empowering our developers to build the company's strategy and shape the future of boating. People joining Click&Boat are always delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

* **Product-Focused:** Our focus is on delivering exceptional products that truly benefit our users.
* **Data-Driven:** We prioritize data-driven decisions to ensure our products meet user needs.
* **Tech for Purpose:** We believe technology is a means to solve real problems, not an end.
* **Full Empowerment**: Our developers are not just coders; they are strategic partners who have a direct impact on our product roadmap and company objectives.
* **Full Transparency**: You'll have access to the entire company strategy and be a key player in achieving our OKRs.
* **AI-Powered Workflows**: We believe in using the best tools to keep our productivity sailing smoothly. Our developers are equipped with top-tier AI tools. We see AI as an efficiency boost, so you can spend your time engineering smarter solutions for our end users.
* **Boring architecture:** we are always seeking the simplest solution for our complex challenges… and that is not simple! (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=msnQbIQFsw4 if you want to know more).
* **Diversity :** We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace, where all individuals are valued and respected.

️ **The Engineering Team ️**

Our engineering team is currently composed of 4 agile squads, each responsible for a specific functional scope. As we expand into the US market, we will grow to 6 squads, with two new squads dedicated to building and scaling our product for US users. Together, the teams build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications that provide a first-class experience for our users: boat owners, customers renting boats, and Click&Boat internal teams.

By joining Click&Boat, you’ll meet a team of talented, committed, and passionate engineers with a lot of product interactions. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of projects quickly, whilst being mentored by talented senior engineers who have made significant contributions at renowned companies like Doctolib (VP of Engineering, Engineering Director & Principal Engineer) and ManoMano.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems! Being a developer at Click&Boat means more than just coding. Our developers are also responsible for preparing their features, collaborating with product managers and designers, monitoring and validating features once in production.

Our stack includes up-to-date Angular, PHP, MySQL, Symfony.

️ Are you the one **we’re looking for? ️**

We are looking to recruit a Senior Engineering Manager who will manage **two squads.**

**You're a Great Fit at Click&Boat if:**

* You are fluent in English. French is a plus.
* You enjoy delivering features that impact the company's KPIs ;
* You have solid experience delivering high-quality feature ;
* You have at least 5 years of experience managing a technical team ;
* You enjoy supporting and coaching your individual contributors, providing regular feedback to help them grow in line with company-wide objectives ;
* You feel comfortable working with various stakeholders across the company ;
* You’re a clear and effective communicator with your teammates.

**What We Value :**

* **Customer Focus:** Understanding our customers and fully embracing our mission will make your journey with us exciting and fulfilling.
* **Curiosity Acumen:** We seek individuals who are curious and eager to learn.
* **Diversity and Inclusion:** We value and actively promote gender diversity and inclusion. We appreciate candidates with diverse backgrounds.
* **Boat Interest:** We appreciate candidates with a background or interest in boating. If you share our passion for the industry, it's a significant advantage.

Make sure to highlight these qualities during your interviews.

**What awaits you on board**

* 8 additional days off;
* Lunch vouchers (Cobee);
* Gym partnerships (Wellhub);
* PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;
* Breakfast every Tuesday morning;
* A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20-minute walk from the sea;
* Team-building activities.
* Hybrid role based in Barcelona, with 3 days per month spent in Paris — around 6 to 9 trips per year.

**Contract: Permanent position**

**Start date: ASAP**

Ready to take the helm and drive our success? Join Click&Boat and be part of a team where your voice truly matters. Let's navigate the future of boating together!

title: Director, Key Accounts
description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.

We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.

By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.

Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

**Director, Key Accounts**

We're seeking a driven, dynamic, and strategic commercial leader to drive growth across our key accounts in Europe. This is a hands-on, high-impact player-coach role focused predominantly on personal account execution paired with informal team leadership and commercial mentoring.

To succeed in this role, you will need a consultative mindset, excellent communication skills, and knowledge of the utilities industry. You will also need a proven track record of commercial execution across large, multi-year, multi-faceted contracts, and experience leading or mentoring a customer-facing team.

**What You'll Do**

* Personally own and grow relationships with a portfolio of our most strategic accounts, serving as the senior commercial relationship owner and executive point of contact.
* Develop and deliver expansion plans across assigned key accounts to execute against business metrics and revenue goals.
* Coach the team on account strategy, executive engagement, and commercial execution on complex, multi-year contracts.
* Identify new workflow improvements and use-case opportunities, helping to upskill the broader customer-facing team in commercial best practices.
* Collaborate with Customer Success Operations, Customer Value Architects, and Product on overall account strategy and execution.
* Develop processes to scale the Key Account Management function as Neara's European business grows.
* Co-present with utilities at key conferences and events across Europe, helping elevate Neara’s market presence.
* Report on account performance, pipeline, and expansion opportunities to senior leadership.

**Who You Are**

* Demonstrated history of personally managing and expanding enterprise-level accounts within complex technical or SaaS environments, ideally operating as a Director of Key Accounts, Director of Sales, Key Account Manager, Client Partner, or in a similar enterprise role.
* Domain exposure to the utilities sector or a similarly complex, technical, infrastructure-heavy industry is highly desirable.
* Experience leading, managing, or mentoring Account Managers or Customer Success Managers, ideally in a player-coach capacity.
* Experience in strategic sales, management consulting, or tech-enabled enterprise environments.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to navigate executive dynamics and foster a collaborative, customer-centric culture internally.
* Fluent in English (required); additional European languages are a plus.

**What We Are Offering You**

* Competitive salary + commission structure.
* Significant development opportunities with scope for lateral and upward movement in a high-growth company.
* Highly meritocratic, non-bureaucratic, and low-ego work culture.
* The opportunity to play a direct, critical role in expanding Neara’s footprint across Europe’s largest utilities to solve real-world infrastructure problems.
* Enjoy the opportunity to work across multiple business areas and build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.

BSB is a large, very popular school for children aged 3 to 18. Our curriculum is based on the English National Curriculum, and we offer a wide range of GCSEs, A levels, BTEC and the International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB), all alongside a significant enrichment programme.
  
  
Approximately 2350 students from more than 74 nationalities attend the school and over 375 staff work at BSB. We are based in three locations, two just outside the city of Barcelona – in Castelldefels, where we have a Primary, Secondary and Pre-University campus, and in the cosmopolitan town of Sitges, where we have another Primary campus. The growth of the school has been accompanied by significant investment over recent years, including the building of a state-of-the art Pre-University Centre (Nexus), a full-sized 4G rugby and football pitch, dedicated STEAM facilities and the new BSB City and Maresme campuses.

All positions are offered with attractive packages including competitive salaries, places for staff children in BSB, and other local benefits.

title: Affiliate Manager
description:
**About PFM**  
Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff.

**About the department**  
Marketing owns how PFM finds, engages, and converts traders across every channel we use to grow. Affiliate and influencer partnerships are one of our biggest acquisition channels - over $60K a month in spend - and as that function matures under our Owned Media team, our priority is turning it into a well-negotiated, well-tracked channel instead of one that runs on relationships alone.

**About the role**  
The Affiliate Manager builds an affiliate channel that creates measurable, profitable growth for PFM: turning the right partner relationships into qualified traffic, conversions, and durable revenue, while protecting deal quality and spend efficiency. This role establishes the commercial discipline and tracking PFM needs to scale partnerships into priority markets with confidence. It backfills our outgoing Affiliate Manager as they step into leading Owned Media, and works alongside our Influencer Partnerships Specialist, providing light day-to-day direction on their pipeline and priorities. Without a dedicated owner here, deals on one of our largest acquisition channels get missed or under-negotiated.

 **Requirements**

**Performance objectives**

**Objective 1 - Build and activate a productive affiliate portfolio**  
**Outcome:** Within the first 6–12 months, the active portfolio is stronger in priority markets and produces a growing share of qualified traffic and attributable conversions - not simply more signed partners.

**Typical tasks:**

* Map priority regions, partner segments, and target accounts with the Head of Owned Media.
* Source and qualify affiliates on audience fit, traffic quality, commercial potential, and brand suitability.
* Move qualified prospects through outreach, negotiation, onboarding, activation, and first performance review.
* Re-engage, expand, or exit existing partners based on contribution and strategic fit.

**Objective 2 - Improve deal quality and partner economics**  
**Outcome:** New and renewed agreements have clear economics and accountable deliverables; spend and effort shift toward partnerships with stronger return.

**Typical tasks:**

* Negotiate commission structures, fees, placements, deliverables, tracking requirements, and review points.
* Model expected cost and return before committing spend or recommending exceptions.
* Document agreed terms and coordinate approvals, contracts, and handoffs.
* Review underperforming deals and recommend renewal, renegotiation, or exit.

**Objective 3 - Make affiliate-driven results measurable and actionable**  
**Outcome:** Leadership can see attributable revenue, cost, and conversion quality by partner; material data gaps are resolved and commercial decisions follow the evidence.

**Typical tasks:**

* Set tracking and attribution requirements before launch and verify links, codes, and reporting access.
* Reconcile partner-reported activity with internal traffic, sales, and commission data alongside Analytics & Data and Finance.
* Investigate material discrepancies, low-quality traffic, and conversion changes through to resolution.
* Turn performance reviews into specific actions on partner mix, terms, creative, placement, or budget.

**Objective 4 - Build a repeatable partnership operating system and content governance**  
**Outcome:** Priority markets have a visible, qualified pipeline; launches and reviews happen on time; agreed placements go live as contracted, and partner content about PFM is accurate and up to date; the channel can scale without losing commercial control or partner experience.

**Typical tasks:**

* Maintain a current deal pipeline with owner, stage, expected value, next step, and decision date.
* Establish onboarding, briefing, compliance, and performance-review standards for partners.
* Coordinate with the Influencer Partnerships Specialist on shared deal governance and measurement without duplicating ownership of influencer negotiations.
* Monitor what partners publish about PFM for accuracy, brand suitability, and compliance, and act on issues through to resolution.
* Verify that agreed placements and deliverables go live on time and as specified, and keep partner-facing offers, promo codes, creatives, and campaign details current.

**What we look for**  
**Must-Have Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in a similar affiliate, influencer, or partnerships role, with hands-on ownership of deal sourcing and negotiation end to end.
* Fluent professional English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong AI proficiency — comfortable using AI as part of daily work, including experience building or using small automations to improve outreach, tracking, or reporting.
* Working knowledge of Docusign and Calendly, or comparable contract and scheduling tools.
* Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, Zoom, and Slack for documentation, scheduling, forms, communication, and remote collaboration.
* Basic working knowledge of partnership/affiliate contract terms, with the ability to identify when Legal or Finance input is required.
* Strong organization and follow-through — able to manage a multi-deal pipeline where a missed follow-up can cost a partnership or measurable revenue.
* Clear, direct communication — able to prepare and communicate deal terms, performance updates, and negotiation outcomes accurately to internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong discretion and judgment, given regular access to spend data, deal terms, and partner performance information.
* A relationship-first negotiation style — able to build trust with partners while still protecting PFM's commercial interests.
* Strong cross-functional coordination skills — comfortable working closely with Analytics & Data, Marketing, Strategic Initiatives, and leadership to bring deals and tracking work to completion.

**Nice to Have**

* Previous experience in a fully remote, global, and multicultural team.
* Experience in a fast-scaling organization where affiliate/partnership processes are still being built and improved.
* Deeper experience with AI integrations, workflow automation, and attribution/tracking tooling beyond basic usage.

**Compensation**  
$3,500 - $4,000 / monthly gross

**Location & work setup**  
Remote, CET-aligned working hours.  
Employment type: Full-time.

 **Benefits**

**Hiring stages**  
We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time. Here's what to expect:

* Application screening – We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role's requirements. You'll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status.
* Video intro + role fit questionnaire – A short async step - no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire, helping us understand your background and fit without either side committing to a live call upfront.
* Discovery HR interview – A conversation with our People team focused on company and culture match - how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like day to day, and what success in this role looks like.
* Practical task – A short, scoped exercise based on a real PFM affiliate/partnership challenge, not an abstract problem, designed to give both sides a realistic view of the work before committing further.
* Professional interview – A conversation with the Head of Owned Media focused on your negotiation experience, how you've owned an affiliate or partnership channel end to end, and how you handle sensitive or ambiguous deal situations.
* Functional interview – A broader professional conversation exploring how you work with commercial teams and partners, how you structure and present data to support business decisions, and how you identify and resolve operational bottlenecks.
* Peer & values conversation – A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM.

If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.  
To keep things fully transparent and mutually fair, we complete a reference check before the formal offer is extended. No surprises - just part of how we make careful, informed decisions on both sides.

**Before applying take into account that:**  

* If you don’t meet every single qualification but believe you can excel in the role based on what it requires - we encourage you to apply.
* We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
* Even if it’s not listed as a formal requirement, we truly value candidates who have clear familiarity with the prop trading industry and us, our mission and what we do.

  
**Not the right fit for this role?**  
If this role isn’t the right match but you have experience in trading operations, customer success, compliance, support, partnerships, or a related area - we still want to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we’ll reach out when a relevant role opens. Every submission is reviewed, and the pool is always the first place we look before opening a new search.

**Alexion’s Global Marketing and Market Access team (GMMA)** is an integrated strategy and operations team, with the core objective to develop disease and brand commercial and access strategies, as well as global marketing materials and negotiation strategies, while working closely with markets for implementation. The team diligently monitors the performance of the business and the effectiveness of our strategies, helping to position our brands for sustained long-term access and success. Our unique culture thrives on collaboration, authenticity, creativity, and pushing boundaries in all that we do to advance patient care.

The Global Brand Strategy Lead, Rare Bone and Endocrine Disorders is a foundational role for the success of the **Hypophosphatasia (HPP)** company strategy with focus on our **Top 21 countries**. You are accountable for leading the development and profitable management of our **Hypophosphatasia** portfolio with full accountability for commercialization. You have a leadership role within a matrix working model between global and local markets and across functions. Working in complex and competitive markets, you are accountable for creating a collaborative and high-performance environment that supports the innovation required to identify and realize substantial value opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Brand Strategy In-Line Products**:

* You are responsible for the VST (Lead of Value Sub team) in which you will refine, and safeguard strategic value propositions based on market events and clinical outcomes. In collaboration with Medical and Market Access teams to develop proposals and business cases for further data generation and RWE

* You lead the DSP (Disease Strategy Plan) development and roll-out. Provide input into strategic planning process (patient funnel, patient journey, patient segmentation, et al). Prioritize the critical success factors and associated tactics coming out of the DSP and lead project workstreams for pull-through. Additionally, you will lead planning meetings with key stakeholders to align on DSP development and enterprise approval.

* You are accountable for ensuring CI and Market Research plans are aligned to commercial strategy for your portfolio and ensure the enterprise is prepared for competitive assets in the marketplace

* You are part of the GPT Core Team member (Global Program Team), keeping the GPT apprised of key programs and workstreams. As well as collaborate and align with key functions and government bodies i.e. Regional Area Heads (US, INTL, JP), GPT, GST, Clinical, Development, Regulatory, SciComms, Training etc.

* You provide regular updates on strategy and global performance to senior leadership, e.g. GCOLT (Global Commercial Leadership Team)

**Launch Strategy**

* You are accountable for driving the Global Pre-Launch strategy and planning 12-18 months prior to launch and providing commercial input into development programs.

* Partnering with (R&D, Operations, Corporate Affairs, Finance, et al) and regional/local teams to develop relevant launch strategy. Additionally, working with regional colleagues to plan the market shaping activities 12-18 months prior to launch

**Business & Commercial Performance**:

* You are responsible for development and evolving the commercial strategy (positioning, messaging, claims, patient/HCP segmentation …etc.). in partnership with Regional Commercial leads to ensure local execution of strategy.

* You are responsible for the development, communication and evolution of long-range global forecasts for your portfolio (LTP)

**Pipeline**:

* As the pipeline evolves, this role will also be instrumental in partnering with R&D, BD and other enterprise functions to support Business Cases for pipeline assets to be assessed by the Leadership team

**You will need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business or life sciences; a Masters degree would be supportive

* Minimum 10+ years in pharmaceutical or biotech industry in roles encompassing strategic pre-launch planning and launch, with global/regional/local experience and thorough understanding of the diverse requirements of Global markets

* Country and/ or above-country leadership experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry with accountability and a proven track record for delivering on business goals in a major healthcare market; PnL responsibility would be supportive

* Broad marketing and commercial experience with demonstrated success across various stages of the brand lifecycle, including pre-launch planning, launch execution, and long-term business planning

* Profound understanding of drug development and commercialization in rare disease

* Solid grasp of ongoing paradigm changes and future trends in healthcare commercialization

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across matrix teams and achieve goals by delivering through others

* Proven experience and knowledge of a broad base of external partners and customers including patients, prescribers, payors, providers and in/out license partners.

* P&L management experience and ability to build a financial Business Case

* Experienced with key global regulations in the field of pharmaceutical compliance and commercialization, including pharmacovigilance

* Excellent communications skills across a diverse set of stakeholders (commercial, clinical, medical, etc.)

**We would prefer you to have:**

* An advanced degree (MBA, MSc or PhD) is preferred

* Pharmaceutical or Biotech experience at the Global, Regional and Local level.

* You bring an entrepreneurial spirit and strategic mindset including innovation and critical thinking with performance-oriented drive.

* You can integrate a variety of perspectives into meaningful strategies and programs.

* You embrace curiosity, collaboration and smart risk taking as a prerequisite for joint success.

* You enthusiastically embrace the diversity of individual healthcare ecosystems as significant opportunity.

* You can relate and connect deeply with various healthcare and business markets to deliver direction and support.

* You can create and mobilize an inclusive work environment of highest integrity and quality, fostering learning, growth, teamwork, individual development and attraction of top talent.

* You possess excellent communication skills and a strong personal presence internally and externally, acting as a strong catalyst and influencer.

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Office

**Job Description**

**Position:** Executive Director, Global Site Strategic Network

**Location:** EMEA, remote

**Type:** Full Time

The **Executive Director, Global Site Strategic Network** is accountable for defining and leading the global strategy for strategic site engagement and partnerships within Global Clinical Operations. The role establishes the strategic architecture, operating principles, governance, portfolio priorities, and performance framework that connect Therapeutic Business Unit (TBU) strategy and Global Clinical Operations priorities with regional and country activation and local site engagement.

The Executive Director shapes how the business identifies, prioritizes, develops, and activates relationships with investigators, health systems, strategic sites, and research networks to improve access to patients, accelerate clinical development, strengthen study delivery, and create differentiated value for customers and TBUs. The role leads the global Site Strategy & Collaborations organization, provides strategic direction through regional Site Network leadership and matrix partners, serves as an executive sponsor for priority partnerships, and advises senior leadership on network strategy, partnership investment, external ecosystem trends, and future capability needs.

**Essential Functions and Other Job Information:**

  

* Define and own the global Site Strategy & Collaborations vision, multi-year strategic roadmap, and priorities aligned with Global Clinical Operations objectives and TBU portfolio strategy.
* Translate TBU therapeutic and portfolio priorities into a differentiated global site-network strategy, defining where, with whom, and how Thermo Fisher should build strategic site relationships to support current and future clinical development needs.
* Establish the global strategic framework for site partnerships, including partnership segmentation, value propositions, engagement principles, governance, decision rights, escalation pathways, and standards for relationship development and activation.
* Lead the global operating model that connects enterprise and TBU strategy with regional Site Network Leads, Feasibility & Site Selection (FSS), Country Operations, and local site teams, enabling one connected strategy with clear ownership and accountability.
* Create a closed-loop mechanism through which regional and local site intelligence informs global and TBU strategy, while global portfolio priorities are translated into practical country and site engagement plans.
* Own global prioritization of strategic sites, health systems, investigators, and research networks using portfolio needs, patient access, performance data, market intelligence, customer strategy, and emerging capability requirements.
* Partner with TBU leaders, Clinical Operations, Medical, Commercial, Business Development, FSS, and Country Operations to embed site strategy early in portfolio planning, customer strategy, proposals, bid defenses, and strategic account discussions.
* Define and govern a global performance framework and differentiated KPIs that demonstrate the operational, strategic, customer, and business value of site partnerships, including proof points that inform investment and prioritization decisions.
* Use data, analytics, external market intelligence, and network insights to identify strategic opportunities, anticipate risks, inform network design, and recommend changes to partnership strategy and operating model.
* Champion innovative partnership models, digital capabilities, data-sharing approaches, and collaboration mechanisms that strengthen site engagement and differentiate Thermo Fisher in the clinical research ecosystem.
* Lead organizational transformation and change initiatives that position Site Strategy & Collaborations as a strategic enterprise capability rather than a transactional or support function.
* Advise senior and executive leadership on site ecosystem trends, strategic partnership opportunities, competitive dynamics, investment choices, and organizational capabilities required to support future growth.
* Represent Thermo Fisher externally at executive customer engagements, strategic partnership discussions, investigator forums, industry events, and other high-level engagements that advance the company's position as a preferred clinical research partner.
* Perform other duties as assigned based on business needs.

**Job Knowledge**

Applies expert knowledge of global clinical operations, strategic site engagement, feasibility, portfolio strategy, investigator and institutional partnerships, clinical trial delivery, and external ecosystem dynamics to shape global strategy and investment priorities. Recognized as an enterprise thought leader who integrates TBU strategy, customer needs, market intelligence, and site-network capabilities to influence organizational design, partnership models, and future business direction.

**Job Complexity**

Leads a global capability at the intersection of TBUs, Global Clinical Operations, regions, countries, and the external site ecosystem. Resolves ambiguity and competing priorities across therapeutic areas, geographies, customers, and functions while making strategic choices that influence network design, partnership investment, organizational capability, and measurable business outcomes.

Leads highly complex initiatives requiring strategic thinking, executive influence, and cross-functional leadership

**Supervision Received / Freedom to act**

Operates with broad strategic autonomy and significant independent judgment in establishing regional priorities, developing strategic partnerships, and executing organizational objectives. Regularly advises executive leadership on site engagement strategy, organizational capabilities, and market trends.

**Interactions / Business Relationships**

Builds and maintains executive relationships with TBU Leaders, Global Clinical Operations leadership, Regional Site Network Leads, FSS leadership, Country Operations, Commercial, Medical, Business Development, Finance, and other cross-functional partners. Externally, engages senior investigators and leaders of strategic research institutions, health systems, and site networks, representing Thermo Fisher as an executive strategic partner.

**Qualifications:**

**Education and Experience:**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic/vocational qualification. Advanced degree (MBA, MS, MPH, PharmD, or equivalent) preferred.
* Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (typically comparable to 15+ years), including significant leadership experience in global clinical operations, site strategy, feasibility, strategic partnerships, project delivery or related areas.
* Demonstrated experience leading director-level and global cross-functional organizations, translating portfolio strategy into operating priorities, establishing strategic external partnerships, and influencing enterprise-level decisions is strongly preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

  

* Global strategy development and enterprise-level strategic thinking
* Therapeutic expertise and portfolio strategy translation into site-network priorities
* Strategic site partnership architecture, segmentation, and governance
* Deep understanding of global clinical operations, feasibility, and the investigator/site ecosystem
* Executive influencing, decision framing, and stakeholder management
* Ability to lead leaders and high-performing teams across complex global and matrix organizations.
* Data-driven decision making, performance analytics, and value demonstration
* Operating model design, governance, and organizational transformation
* Commercial acumen, customer strategy, and business development engagement
* Strong business, financial, and resource-allocation acumen
* Ability to drive talent strategy, succession planning, and high-performing team development
* Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills
* Executive leadership and organizational transformation
* Ability to travel globally as required.

**Policy & Strategy:**

* Defines and leads the Global Site Strategic Network aligned with Global Clinical Operations and TBU priorities. Establishes the strategic partnership framework, operating model, governance, decision rights, performance standards, and investment principles that guide global, regional, country, and site-level engagement.
* Translates TBU portfolio strategy into site-network direction and uses local and regional intelligence to inform enterprise decisions. Recommends and leads strategic changes that influence clinical operations capabilities, external partnership strategy, and future business direction.

**Management Role:** Leads a global organization through direct leaders and matrix partnerships. Accountable for organizational strategy, performance, talent and succession, resource planning, capability development, and execution of global business objectives.

Establishes clear accountability across global, regional, and country interfaces and develops high-performing leaders who can translate strategy into consistent local activation and measurable value.

**Working Conditions and Environment**

The role is performed in a home office or office environment with regular interaction across global teams utilizing digital collaboration technologies.

Requires frequent domestic and international travel, approximately **40–60%**, to support strategic site and investigator engagement, executive customer meetings, global and regional leadership meetings, industry conferences, site visits, and organizational priorities.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work in a stationary position for extended periods.
* Frequent use of computer systems and digital technologies.
* Ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Travel by air or ground transportation.
* Ability to lift and carry light materials consistent with normal business travel.

We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

  
  

**Commercial Execution & Enablement Manager – Healthcare – Barcelona**

  

**Please note, internally, this position is titled: Manager, Sales Operations**

**Meet the team:**

You'll join Dexcom's growing Commercial Excellence organization, where customer engagement, commercial deployment, enablement, analytics, and field execution come together to drive scalable growth across EMEA. Our mission is simple: ensure commercial strategy translates into consistent execution, execution translates into measurable impact, and impact translates into sustainable growth.

We serve as strategic partners to Country Leadership, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Market Access, and Sales Enablement teams, helping define what great looks like, identify scalable best practices, and accelerate adoption across EMEA. By connecting insights across markets, enabling smarter customer engagement, and driving commercial transformation, we ensure every market benefits from the collective experience, innovation, and success of the broader organization.

**Where you come in:**

* You serve as a strategic partner to the Director of Commercial Excellence, helping shape and advance the regional commercial enablement agenda and driving scalable commercial execution across EMEA.
* You lead the development, standardization, and adoption of commercial execution practices across segmentation, customer prioritization, account planning, call planning & tracking, & omnichannel engagement.
* You translate customer intelligence and commercial strategy into practical field processes, playbooks, and tools that help teams prioritize opportunities, prepare for customer interactions, and take the optimal next action.
* You support go-to-market transformations, new field-team deployments, market expansions, and commercial go-direct initiatives as a strategic advisor across customer strategy, role design, segmentation, targeting, engagement, execution, enablement, and performance measurement.
* You identify, benchmark, and scale successful practices across markets, connecting countries with similar commercial archetypes and ensuring innovative approaches can be rapidly adopted across the region.
* You partner with Sales Leadership and Sales Enablement to harmonize customer-facing roles, competencies, incentives, coaching standards, sales narrative expectations, and capability development approaches while maintaining appropriate flexibility for local market needs.
* You help design connected engagement approaches that coordinate field, inside sales, marketing, medical, market access, and service interactions into a more relevant and consistent customer journey.
You establish performance measures and lead change activation efforts across new technologies, processes, operating models, and commercial capabilities, using insights, champion networks, stakeholder engagement, and adoption programs to accelerate business value realization.  

**What makes you successful:**

* You have significant experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Excellence, or a related customer-facing enablement discipline within a complex, multi-market organization.
* You possess deep expertise in segmentation, targeting, customer engagement, account planning, call planning, field execution, coaching excellence, sales effectiveness, and commercial performance management.
* You have successfully led large-scale commercial transformation initiatives and understand how to move organizations from strategy to execution through structured change activation and stakeholder engagement.
* You excel at creating scalable frameworks, playbooks, operating models, execution standards, and governance processes that can be adopted across diverse markets.
* You have a demonstrated ability to identify patterns, connect insights across countries, benchmark performance, and translate local successes into regional best practices.
* You understand how commercial deployment, customer engagement, capability development, coaching, incentives, analytics, and technology work together to drive sustainable commercial performance.
* You are skilled at facilitating workshops, leading cross-functional initiatives, influencing senior stakeholders, and building alignment across diverse teams and geographies.
* You are comfortable using customer, field, and performance insights to identify opportunities, prioritize investments, measure impact, and continuously improve commercial execution.
You thrive in highly collaborative environments and can effectively lead through influence, partnership, credibility, and strategic thinking rather than direct authority.  

**What you’ll get:**

* A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community .
* A full and comprehensive benefits program.
* Growth opportunities on a global scale.
* Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.  

**Travel Required:**

25 to 50%  

  

**Experience and Education Requirements:**

Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree with 8-12 years of industry experience2-5 years of previous management or lead experience  

  

**Flex/Hybrid Workplace:** Your primary location will be your assigned Dexcom site but you may work part of the week from a home office. You must live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically within an hour’s commute).

  

*To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.*

At Dexcom, we are committed to providing a fair and inclusive recruitment process, and welcome candidates of all genders and gender identities to apply. If any wording in this description appears unintentionally gendered or exclusionary, please be assured this is not intentional.

Should a reasonable accommodation be necessary to aid a disability, requests should be sent to Dexcom Talent Acquisition at talentacquisition@dexcom.com .

title: Product Owner, Xsolla Partner Network
description:
**About You**
-------------

We are looking for a **Product Owner** to join the team behind Xsolla Partner Network (XPN). The role is based in the US, and we're open to strong candidates globally. Partner Network connects game publishers with content creators to drive discovery, engagement, and revenue.  
  
XPN is a two-sided marketplace. We help publishers run creator marketing campaigns (xsolla.com/partner-network), and we give creators a way to join those campaigns, along with tools to manage and grow their channels (xsolla.com/for/creators). Each side has its own users and goals, and each shapes the other. Helping both sides succeed together is what makes this role so interesting.  
  
You'll work closely with customers on both sides and with a collaborative team that's building something new in the creator economy. You'll bring what you learn back to the Product Director and the team, help shape where the product goes, and then work alongside design and engineering to bring it to life.  
  
This is a hands-on role that mixes customer conversations, product definition, and day-to-day delivery. If you enjoy turning what you learn from customers into shipped features, and you like doing it with a team that moves fast and supports each other, we'd love to meet you.

### **About Us**

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **Research and discovery.** Get to know both sides of the XPN marketplace: the game publishers running creator campaigns and the creators bringing those campaigns to life. Talk with customers, gather insights, and keep up with trends in the creator economy and gaming. What you learn shapes where the product goes next.
* **Coordinate the roadmap.** Work with the Product Director to turn insights into priorities. Bring ideas and recommendations, balance publisher and creator needs, and help build a roadmap the whole team is excited about.
* **Write product requirements.** Turn ideas into clear, well-scoped PRDs that give design and engineering what they need to build with confidence.
* **Manage delivery.** Organize the work in Jira and keep design, engineering, and QA aligned and moving from kickoff through release.
* **Track what matters.** Define and follow the metrics that show how XPN is working for publishers and creators, and use them to guide what we build next.
* **Keep everyone connected.** Be the hub for product communication. Share project status, research, and customer insights with the product team. Keep Business Development, Customer Success, and Marketing up to date on what's shipping and what it means for our partners.

### **Requirements:**

* **Product experience.** 3+ years in product management or product ownership, shipping software alongside a dedicated engineering team.
* **Customer insight.** You enjoy talking with customers and turning those conversations into insights that shape product decisions. You're comfortable serving more than one type of user and finding solutions that work for everyone involved.
* **Clear writing.** You write product requirements that are easy to follow and help the team get aligned quickly.
* **Engineering partnership.** You work closely with engineers day to day, making scope and sequencing decisions together, and you're comfortable managing the backlog and tracking work in Jira.
* **Cross-team communication.** You enjoy keeping people across the company informed and being a go-to resource for product questions.
* **Adaptability.** You're energized by a fast-moving, globally distributed team and comfortable making progress while the picture is still coming together.
* **Video game marketing.** You understand how games find and grow their audiences, including user acquisition, community building, and influencer campaigns. We prefer candidates with experience in the creator economy or influencer marketing.
* **Creator platform familiarity.** You know how creators work on YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, or Kick, including their analytics, audience growth, and monetization tools.

### **Nice-to-Have:**

* **Marketplace or platform experience.** You've worked on two-sided marketplaces or platform products.
* **Partner commercial models.** Experience with revenue-share or performance-based partner programs.
* **Campaign attribution.** Experience with tracking links, conversion attribution, or measuring marketing performance.
* **Data comfort.** You can pull and explore your own data with analytics tools.

Salary range based on US location only. This position is open for global remote. Salary will be determined based on location and experience.

**Benefits:**  
We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, unlimited Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:**  
Xsolla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the Fair Chance Act.

**Rights Under the Fair Chance Act:**  
Applicants are encouraged to inquire about their rights under the Fair Chance Act. If you have questions regarding our hiring practices, please contact careers@xsolla.com.

*By submitting the following job application form, you consent to Xsolla processing your data for career-related inquiries and potential employment opportunities. We process your data in accordance with this**Xsolla Privacy Notice for Job Applicants**. Please direct any inquiries regarding your data privacy to* *careers@xsolla.com**.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: SRE Manager (VPN)
description:
**Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default**

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: **privacy is a fundamental human right**. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 700+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of.

**The Team:**

Proton VPN gives millions of people a private connection to the internet, including people in countries where the internet is censored. It runs on thousands of bare-metal servers. We choose the hardware, the datacenters, and the networks ourselves, and we operate all of them.

The VPN Site Reliability Engineering team builds and runs this fleet. It has eight engineers: six site reliability engineers and two engineers who look after day-to-day fleet health. The fleet runs Debian, is automated with Ansible and Python, and is monitored with Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, and Grafana. The team has kept the service stable through several years of fast growth.

**The role:**

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead this team. You will report to the VPN Engineering Director and work from our Geneva or Barcelona office.

The fleet keeps growing as more people use Proton VPN. To stay ahead of that growth, the team is investing in two areas, and you will lead both.

1. Automation. Engineers still do much of the provisioning, deployment, and repair work by hand. We want software to do that work, so that a fix or a new location reaches the fleet quickly and safely.

2. Observability. We know when a server is down. We do not yet know when users in one country are getting poor throughput. We want to find a problem that affects one server or one country while it is still small.

We chose a simple stack on purpose, and we plan to keep it and extend it.

This is a management role, so you will not write production code. You do need to be technical enough to read the team's code, question its designs, and examine its postmortems in detail.

**What you will do:**

* Manage and develop a team of eight engineers.
* Decide what the team automates and measures first, and deliver that plan.
* Own the reliability of the Proton VPN fleet, including SLOs, error budgets, incident response, and postmortems.
* Build monitoring that shows what users experience in each country, starting with throughput.
* Replace manual provisioning, deployment, and repair work with tooling that ships changes to the fleet quickly and safely.
* Set the engineering standards for the team, and coach engineers to solve operational problems with software.
* Plan capacity and new locations with VPN product engineering, Proton's infrastructure teams, and our network and datacenter providers.

**What we are looking for:**

* Several years of experience managing site reliability, infrastructure, or platform teams.
* Experience leading a team from manual operations to automated ones, with results you can describe.
* Strong technical judgment on large Linux fleets. You can review a design, read Python and Ansible, and find the gaps in a postmortem.
* Experience owning the reliability of a production service, including SLOs, error budgets, incident response, and postmortems.
* Experience building or rebuilding the monitoring of a production service, and getting engineers to rely on it.
* Experience running physical infrastructure, or a clear willingness to learn it.
* Experience developing engineers, giving direct feedback, and addressing underperformance.
* Experience delivering projects that depend on teams outside your own.
* The habit of setting your own priorities. We will give you goals, and you will decide with the team how to reach them.
* Clear writing in strategy documents, incident reports, and engineering standards.
* A commitment to privacy. Proton VPN keeps no logs of user activity, and you will have to improve observability within that limit.

**Bonus points for:**

* Deep networking knowledge: routing, peering, tunnelling protocols such as WireGuard and OpenVPN, and packet-level debugging.
* Experience with censorship circumvention, or with running infrastructure in restricted network environments.
* Experience operating a fleet across many countries, including the vendor and legal work involved.
* A background as a software engineer, in Python or another language.

**What We Offer**

* **Work that Matters:** millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable.
* **Stock Options:** at Proton, we all have the opportunity to be owners of the company. From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
* **Technology:** you'll get the right hardware and the right software you need to do your best work.
* **Learning & Development:** we invest in your growth because sharp people make us better. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career because you'll be thrown into real challenges, with real ownership, from day one.
* **Employee Benefits:** your wellbeing isn't an afterthought. We offer strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support so you can bring your best self to work every day
* **In-Person Collaboration:** Amazing things happen when passionate, smart, and purposeful people get together in the same room. With offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London and more, you'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face with people who genuinely care about what they're building
* **Food:** Lunch and snacks are on us every day in our offices so you can focus on the work and not on what's for lunch.
* **Transport:** getting to the office shouldn't cost you. We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking, whichever works for you.
* **Flexible Working:** you own your schedule. Set hours that work for you and your team — because outcomes matter more than when the clock says you started.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

**Candidate Privacy Notice**

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

*Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.*

*To learn more about our privacy policy, please visit* *our privacy policy page**.*

**Compensation range**
  
**Barcelona** 62,000-95,000 euros gross annually\*
  
Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process  

* *Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience*
