title: Senior Category Manager, Home - Bedding UK/EU
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

**OUR CULTURE**

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**

**Senior Category Manager, Bedding - UK/EU**

We are seeking a regional **Senior Category Manager, Bedding UK/EU** to join our growing team reporting into the Head of Home UK/EU. This role is suited to a data-driven product obsessed all-rounder. It leads the execution of merchandising strategy across the Bedding category, with responsibility for driving regional performance through strong product execution, trading, and customer insight. In this role, you will play a key part in scaling Quince's value proposition in international markets by delivering a compelling regional assortment, optimizing the customer experience, and partnering cross-functionally to bring high-quality products to market.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end merchandising for the Bedding category across UK/EU including assortment execution, launches, and performance tracking
* Execute regional merchandising strategy in partnership with US Product Merchandising and international regional merchandising peers
* Contribute to product ideation, helping shape new product opportunities and business cases
* Work cross-functionally with Product and Regional Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Technical Design, and Sourcing to deliver successful product launches—balancing inventory, go-to-market execution, and product quality (fit, sizing, and margin)
* Analyse trading performance (sales, returns, margin) and take ownership of actions to improve results
* Support pricing and assortment decisions for the region
* Own product catalogue management and administration, including product setup, data accuracy, and system maintenance
* Build site merchandising strategy, including PDP improvements roadmap and customer journey optimisations
* Monitor ratings, reviews, and returns to identify and support product quality improvements
* Manage regional product samples and merchandising assets
* Maintain merchandising reports, tools, trackers, and pricing files
* Take ownership of evaluating regional product compliance requirements and partner with Sourcing and Quality teams to execute

**Qualifications required:**

* Role is based in London / Madrid or Berlin with 4 days per week in-office requirement
* 8-10 years of retail buying or category experience in Home Textiles / Bedding, with demonstrated ownership of category performance
* E-commerce and/or DTC experience, with exposure to both startup and established (blue-chip) brands preferred
* Proven track record of progressing within an organisation and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
* Bachelor's Degree, preferred
* Strong product awareness, with a commercial mindset and attention to detail
* Product obsessed, with experience leveraging data tools and external sources to drive results
* Critical eye to anticipate customer needs (both the "science" and "art" of retail merchandising)
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using data to inform trading and merchandising decisions (e.g. sales, margin, return rates)
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in both executional and strategic support roles
* Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Planning, Design, Sourcing, or Marketing
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with particular ability to influence through concise written narrative
* Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success
* Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity and change.

**WHY QUINCE?**

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

* Define and evolve the visual and functional design guidelines that ensure quality and consistency across all Mars Veterinary Health Europe projects.
* Drive cost savings and innovation in design, ensuring continuous improvement and efficiency across our network of over 860 clinics.
* Oversee the entire design process for all projects, from inception to post-project review, ensuring a premium pet, client, and associate experience.

This strategic role reports directly to the Director of Construction and is integral to the leadership team's transformational agenda. * 7–10+ years in design, with 3-5 years in a strategic leadership capacity, ideally in healthcare or veterinary industries.
* Experience aligning design with veterinary regulations and leading large-scale initiatives like clinic renovations or digital platform rollouts.
* Mastery of design system tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch) and a deep understanding of inclusive design for clinical workflows.
* **Native-level Spanish language proficiency (written and spoken) alongside fluent business English**.
* Strong analytical skills, excellent time management, and the ability to work under pressure.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally as needed.

### **What we offer**

* A senior leadership role with a global impact on the design and experience of hundreds of veterinary clinics.
* The opportunity to work flexibly from several major European cities.
* A key role in a strategic, forward-thinking team dedicated to innovation and quality.
* Comprehensive wellbeing programs and clear development paths within a global organization.

### **About us**

Mars Veterinary Health (MVH) Europe is a family of leading Veterinary care providers committed to creating A BETTER WORLD FOR PETS. Our network includes trusted brands such as AniCura and Linnaeus, operating over 450 animal hospitals and clinics across 18 European countries. Together, our teams deliver high-quality, modern Veterinary care ensuring peace of mind for pet owners through excellent access and patient safety.

At MVH Europe, we prioritize a culture of accountability, inclusion, and wellbeing. We believe our purpose—to make A BETTER WORLD FOR PETS—starts with building a better world for our people. We support our teams through comprehensive wellbeing programmes, clear development and career paths and a shared passion for delivering exceptional outcomes in Veterinary care.

title: Education Centre Director
description:
About Boundless Life

Boundless Life is redefining the way families live, work, and learn by empowering them to embrace a nomadic lifestyle that fosters deeper connections and personal growth. We provide family-friendly accommodations, an innovative education system that travels with you, and vibrant communities of like-minded individuals.

Since our founding in 2021, we’ve rapidly expanded to eight locations across Europe, Asia, and Latin America, bringing together over 200 team members from diverse backgrounds. Our growth reflects our commitment to transforming the experience economy and making a meaningful impact on how families integrate work, education, and exploration into their lives.

At Boundless Life, we believe in the power of community and the importance of a holistic approach to education. Our programs are designed to inspire curiosity, build resilience, and nurture a global perspective. We combine a project-based, place-based learning with the freedom to live and learn anywhere, for families who want more than a traditional school can offer. Our Education Centres are the heart of everything we do.

Role Overview

Estepona is one of our most established and beloved locations — a flagship of what the Boundless model is. The Education Centre Director who joins here will inherit something that is already working and will be responsible for taking it further.

This is a role for a leader who can come into an existing team, earn trust quickly, raise the bar through coaching and consistency, and build on strong foundations without disrupting what is already good. You are not here to reinvent. You are here to lead, deepen, and improve.

As Education Centre Director, you are the educational leader of the location. You are responsible for how the learning happens and how it is brought to life by your team. You know your educators deeply, coach them continuously, hold high standards, and ensure every cohort delivers on the Boundless promise.You will report directly to the General Manager, with a dotted reporting line to the Head of Education Excellence.

This structure allows you to focus primarily on pedagogical leadership, instructional coaching, and developing your educator team, while the General Manager owns the broader location operations. The role demands someone who is energised by that scale, not overwhelmed by it.

What You'll Do

*Educator Leadership and Team Development*

* Lead, coach, and manage an established team of educators through structured 1:1s, regular classroom observations, and direct, specific feedback
* Set clear expectations for performance and conduct from day one, address gaps independently, and build individual development plans for every member of the team
* Hold a high bar consistently — this means celebrating what is working and naming what is not, without waiting for a formal review cycle
* Build and maintain a team culture that is engaged and resilient through an intense cohort calendar and a demanding daily schedule
* Contribute to hiring decisions alongside the Head of Education Excellence when the team expands or changes

*Curriculum Execution and Educational Quality*

* Ensure the Boundless curriculum is implemented consistently and with fidelity to our global methodology and standards — you do not design the curriculum, you make sure it comes to life as intended
* Ensure project-based and place-based learning happen on the ground, incorporating the extraordinary context of the location meaningfully and in alignment with global curriculum standards
* Observe classes regularly and give educators specific, actionable feedback that leads to real change
* Surface implementation challenges to the global education team and bring solutions alongside them

*Family Relationships*

* Serve as a trusted, visible presence for families — including those who are returning to Boundless and have high expectations of the experience
* Handle family concerns and escalations independently and with confidence, without unnecessary escalation to global leadership
* Contribute to a strong admissions and intake experience that sets every cohort up well

*Running the Education Centre*

* Lead the essential day-to-day running of the Education Centre in close partnership with the General Manager and central teams.
* Own educator administration, family communication, safeguarding, and the smooth delivery of ECAs and field trips.
* Support local partners, systems and practical centre needs where required, while keeping educational leadership and people development as the priority.
* You will be involved in the Boundless Summer Camp cohorts, maintaining the same standards of team leadership and family experience.

Role Requirements

* You have meaningful leadership experience and have directly supervised, coached and developed a team of 8 - 10+ staff. Ideally, you will have led a microschool or similarly hands-on learning environment that requires a holistic view of people, pedagogy, families and day-to-day delivery.
* Experience in excellent curriculum execution.
* You can observe a learning environment, see clearly what is and is not working, and give an educator specific and honest feedback. You understand PBL and place-based learning as practices, not just frameworks.
* Proven experience in delivering high quality customer experiences. *You are exceptional with families.* The location has returning families who love this community. You can hold difficult conversations, manage high expectations, and maintain trust even when something has gone wrong.

You'll Also Be Valued For

* You bring an entrepreneurial spirit: resourceful, proactive and comfortable building solutions in a fast-moving environment without waiting for a complete playbook.
* You are aligned with non-traditional education and understand project-based and experiential learning in practice, not only in theory.
* *You are a people developer.* You have managed a team, conducted observations and given specific feedback, had hard performance conversations independently, and genuinely made the people around you better. Coaching your team is not a task on your list — it is the work.
* *You earn trust in established environments.* You do not arrive and immediately try to change everything. You listen first, build credibility, and lead from within the culture — while still being willing to raise the bar and name what needs to improve.
* *You are energised by scale and intensity.* Sixty to seventy students, an international team, a packed cohort calendar, and a community of families who are living and working alongside each other. This is the environment you thrive in.
* *Spanish language skills or a connection to Spain are a genuine asset for this role.*

What Success Looks Like

In three months: you have earned the trust of the team, completed a full round of classroom observations, every educator is clear on what is expected of them, and families feel the leadership of the EC is strong and present.

In the long term, success in this role is measured against three things:

* 85% or more of families report satisfaction with their overall Boundless Education experience, measured through our termly NPS and satisfaction survey
* 85% or more of educators and facilitators in the centre meet or exceed their role-specific impact metrics
* Staff turnover is low and staff engagement is high, with 80% or more of the team reporting high engagement in our termly pulse survey

Who You'll Work With

You report to the location General Manager, who owns location operations, with a dotted reporting line to the Head of Education Excellence, who leads educational quality and development across all Boundless locations globally.

Why Join Us

Estepona is one of Boundless Life's flagship locations: with its all year round appeal, it has a strong and returning family community, and a team that cares deeply about the work. You will have real responsibility, real autonomy, a platform that is already performing well and the chance to make it even better.

Beyond the work itself, joining Boundless means being part of a mission-driven team that genuinely believes education can be done differently. You will be part of a model that does not exist at scale anywhere else in the world — place-based, project-driven, and designed for families who have chosen a different kind of life. You will also benefit from:

title: Video Producer
description:
**About Frontiers**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

**About the role**

We're looking for a **Video Producer** to join our Visual Design team and work closely with the Senior Video Producer to expand and accelerate Frontiers' video storytelling. In this role, you'll take ownership of video productions from planning and filming through to post-production, creating interviews, talking-head content, b-roll, and studio shoots for company-wide communications and campaigns.

As a second videographer, you'll have the opportunity to lead independent shoots while also supporting larger productions led by the Senior Video Producer. You'll combine strong technical video skills with excellent organization, ensuring that shoots run smoothly, footage meets Frontiers' creative and technical standards, and media assets are efficiently managed throughout the production process.

You'll work closely with colleagues across Communications and Visual Design, as well as researchers, authors, employees, external contributors, and production partners. If you enjoy working both behind the camera and behind the scenes, solving problems on the go, and creating high-quality visual content in a fast-paced environment, you'll thrive in this role.

You'll also contribute to improving video production workflows by using technology, AI-powered tools, and consistent production practices to streamline scheduling, media management, transcription, subtitling, and post-production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate video shoots end-to-end, including scheduling interviews, talking-head sessions, b-roll, and studio productions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute call sheets, coordinate shoot logistics, and ensure crews and on-camera participants have clear information about locations, timings, requirements, and expectations.
* Scout and book filming locations, studios, and meeting spaces, coordinating travel arrangements and equipment transportation for shoots outside Lausanne.
* Prepare, test, organize, and maintain camera, lighting, audio, and studio equipment, ensuring all production kits are ready for each assignment.
* Independently film interviews, talking-heads, b-roll, and studio content, operating professional camera, lighting, and audio equipment to a consistently high standard.
* Work as a second camera operator and provide technical support on larger and multi-camera productions led by the Senior Video Producer.
* Welcome and brief on-camera participants, helping guests feel comfortable and confident throughout the filming process while ensuring required release forms and consent documentation are completed.
* Ingest, back up, organize, and archive raw footage following established folder structures, file-naming conventions, and media management practices.
* Support post-production by cutting and editing footage, applying colour grading and established brand guidelines, creating and using motion graphics, and preparing subtitles and AI-assisted transcriptions.
* Work with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and other relevant production tools to support high-quality video delivery.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external production partners, including freelance crew, studios, equipment suppliers, editors, and post-production specialists.
* Identify and resolve technical, logistical, and production challenges independently while maintaining quality, schedules, and production standards.
* Contribute to improving video production workflows, playbooks, and best practices, helping the team increase production capacity and deliver content efficiently.

  
**Requirements**  

* 2–3 years of hands-on experience in video production, videography, or a similar role, with experience taking video projects from production planning and filming through to post-production.
* Strong technical video production skills, including professional camera operation, lighting, and audio recording, with the ability to independently deliver high-quality footage.
* A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating relevant camera, lighting, sound, editing, and/or studio production experience.
* Proficiency in video editing and post-production tools, particularly Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with experience in editing, colour grading, and Adobe After Effects/motion graphics.
* Strong production coordination and organizational skills, with experience managing shoot schedules, call sheets, locations, equipment, travel, production documentation, and digital media organization, including footage ingestion, file naming, folder structures, and backups.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 and project collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
* Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal teams, external production partners, and on-camera participants.
* A proactive and solutions-oriented approach, with the ability to troubleshoot technical and logistical challenges calmly and independently while maintaining production and brand standards.
* Familiarity with AI-powered tools for transcription, subtitling, or production workflows is an advantage.
* Willingness and ability to travel for filming assignments and flexibility to accommodate changing production schedules.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Media Production, Film, Communications, or a related field is preferred, although relevant practical experience will also be considered.
* Experience in corporate communications, science communication, or event filming is an advantage.

  
**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
* Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

***Equal opportunity statement***

***Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.***

These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.

At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.

**Job Role / Responsibilities**

As a Microsoft Security Engineer, you will be responsible for onboarding clients to our managed security service, with Microsoft Sentinel at the centre of the solution. You will configure and integrate Sentinel environments, onboard and validate log sources, and prepare each deployment for effective monitoring and operational handover to the Security Operations Centre.

Your primary focus will be the technical delivery of new Microsoft Sentinel onboardings. This includes workspace and connector configuration, data collection design, log-source integration, ingestion filtering, validation, detection tuning and the production of high-level design and implementation documentation. You will work closely with clients, architects and SOC teams to ensure each deployment is supportable, secure and aligned with the contracted service scope.

The role also requires hands-on experience, or a clear ability to develop quickly, in onboarding Microsoft Defender XDR workloads such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Who we are**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organisation at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society.

To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4

**About the Role**:

Frontiers is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own a defined product, platform, or workflow area within our publishing ecosystem. The exact domain — submission, peer review, production, partnerships, AI, or another area — will be confirmed at the offer stage based on where the business need and the candidate's strengths best align. This description sets the bar and shape of the role common to all our Senior PM positions, so that candidates can be assessed once and matched to the right opening.

You will own your product end to end: understanding user and business needs, defining the roadmap, working with engineering, design and operational stakeholders to ship it, and being accountable for the outcomes it produces. You will operate within Frontiers' one-platform strategy — favouring shared, scalable workflows over bespoke, one-off solutions — regardless of which domain you land in.

You will not wait for a perfect brief. You will spot the problem, make a call with the data you have, and go find the rest. We want someone who treats a blocker as a puzzle to solve, not a reason to pause.

Key Responsibilities

* Roadmap ownership: Define and drive the roadmap for your product area, balancing user needs, business priorities, and platform constraints into a clear, sequenced plan.
* Requirements discipline: Gather, document, and reconcile requirements from multiple stakeholders — internal teams, partners, or end users — into a coherent, scalable product definition rather than a pile of one-off requests.
* Cross-team delivery: Work with and through engineering, design, and other product teams to ship your roadmap, tracking dependencies and resolving conflicts without necessarily having direct authority over every team involved.
* User- and stakeholder-facing discovery: Engage directly with the people who use or depend on your product — authors, editors, reviewers, partners, or internal teams — to uncover real underlying needs and validate that proposed solutions solve them.
* Creative, pragmatic solutioning: Where requirements conflict with simplicity or scale, propose solutions — configuration over customisation, shared workflows over bespoke branches — that satisfy the intent without fragmenting the platform.
* Evidence-led decisions: Steer your roadmap with data: define the metrics that matter for your area, track them, and show what you measured, what you changed, and what moved. Be ready to change course when the data says you were wrong.
* Quality and risk ownership: Hold the bar for whatever your product area delivers, and manage risk transparently when timelines, dependencies, or stakeholder expectations are under pressure. Define acceptance criteria, test with real users before release, and own post-launch quality.
* Product vision: Set a clear vision for your product area and connect it to Frontiers' one-platform strategy, so every roadmap choice traces back to a purpose.
* Business outcome ownership: Build and defend the business case for your product. Set the investment, expected return and payback, and answer for whether it was worth it.
* Team leadership: Lead your squad of engineers, designers and analysts toward shared goals. Coach, set direction and raise the bar, even without formal reporting lines.
* Managing up: Give the Head of Product and senior leadership regular, candid updates on progress, risks and trade-offs. Bring a recommendation with each decision you need.
* AI and automation: Find where AI agents and automation can remove manual work or improve outcomes in your area. Then scope, ship and measure them.
* Launch and adoption: Take your product from idea through launch to adoption. Plan rollout, train users, then track usage and iterate until the outcome moves.
* Resourceful problem-solving: When data, access or alignment is missing, say what you need, from whom and how you will get it. Keep moving in the meantime.

  
**Requirements**  

* Clarity of thought: You think critically and bring structure and clear rationale to ambiguous, cross-domain problems.
* Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, ideally including ownership of a multi-stakeholder, operations-heavy, or platform-level product.
* Requirements practitioner: Proven ability to gather, document, and unify requirements from multiple demanding stakeholders into a coherent product definition.
* Technical literacy: Comfortable discussing workflows, data, and system design with engineers, and reading the evidence behind a problem, without needing to be a domain specialist on day one.
* User-centric design: A track record of turning a complex process into an experience that different types of users can complete with confidence.
* Cross-team influence: Experience delivering through other teams and aligning multiple roadmaps toward a shared outcome, including without direct authority over every team involved.
* Outcomes: You can point to what you measured, what you changed, and what moved as a result of your product work.
* Ownership and agency: You take responsibility without being asked. When you hit an obstacle, you ask "how do I get this done?" and propose a path. You treat mistakes as information and move on quickly.
* Domain exposure: Background in academic publishing, SaaS platforms, multi-tenant B2B products, or AI/ML products is a plus, but strong learning agility can substitute for direct domain experience.

  
**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
* Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
* Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

*Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.*

title: X-ray/TEM Postdoctoral Researcher
description:
**X-ray/TEM Postdoctoral Researcher**
=====================================

Reference

2026-IMPRESS-1

Deadline

15/11/2026

Division

Experiments

#### **Institution**

ALBA is the Spanish synchrotron light source, a large research infrastructure operating thirteen beamlines, complementary facilities, and an Electron Microscopy Center, this last in partnership with other institutions. Currently constructing multiple more beamlines, expanding the Electron Microscopy Center, and integrating advanced data analytics, it sums up a wide range of infrastructures geared toward finding solutions to societal challenges.

Located in Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain), it is funded by the Spanish Government (Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación) and the Catalan Government (Generalitat de Catalunya, Departament de Recerca i Universitats). The synchrotron light produced by 3 GeV electrons is used by thousands of researchers to analyse and understand the properties and functionality of matter, spanning a wide variety of fields, such as catalytic research, health, energy production/storage, environmental research, communication technologies, or cultural heritage.

Our highly motivated staff works in a multidisciplinary work environment with an atmosphere formed by lived diversity, inclusion and respect for our colleagues. One of the goals of our gender equality plan is to reach parity within the Consortium’s different divisions and offices, and several actions have been taken to encourage applications from women mostly in scientific, engineer and technical job positions.

Located close to Barcelona in a natural park and well connected by car and public transportation, with excellent connectivity to the world and an employer who understands the importance of life-work balance.

Facing an upgrade to ALBA II, a 4th generation facility, which will increase dramatically brightness and coherent flux, ALBA is in a phase of growth and dynamics. Being a part of the ALBA team will promote your career and will give you the opportunities to explore new territories.

For more information, you can take a look on our history watching this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gHMqiH4qBAo

#### **Tasks**

This postdoctoral position is dedicated to scientific and technical methods for correlative operando X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) and (Scanning) Transmission Electron Microscopy (S)TEM within the frame of the IMPRESS project (Interoperable electron Microscopy Platform for advanced RESearch and Services), funded by HORIZON-INFRA-2022-TECH-01-01.

The IMPRESS project aims to develop an interoperable platform based on a modular and standardized cartridge concept. The cartridges are designed to be inserted into TEM specimen and aperture holders, as well as other instruments for preparation and characterization, including surface science tools, transport measurements, microfocus X-ray tomography instruments, and synchrotrons. Within IMPRESS, ALBA is involved in the development of a MEMS-based micro-reactor for correlative photocatalytic experiments in TEM and synchrotron beamlines for CO2 reduction reaction and generation of high value products.

The selected person will report to the Interdisciplinary and Multimodal Section Head and will work in close synergy with the Interface X-ray/TEM and Methodology groups, with beamline scientists, the Joint Electron Microscopy Center at ALBA (JEMCA), and with the project partners. The role emphasis is on the testing of the microreactor prototypes in the (S)TEM and x-ray beamlines.

Specifically, the responsibilities will include:

• Executing the commissioning, operation and maintenance of micro-cell reactor systems for catalysis research.

* Contributing to define procedures for operando and in-situ correlative (S)TEM/X-ray analysis services within a network of experts and under consideration of the international community.

* Contributing to the improvement of the micro-cell reactor system and the development of a true multi-technique approach that will benefit staff, collaborators, and external users.

* Supporting staff and collaborators in (S)TEM and x-ray experiments making use of the micro-cell reactor systems.

* Analysing and interpreting multimodal experimental data.

* Disseminating results through peer-reviewed publications, conference contributions, project deliverables and reports.

#### **Requirements**

The requirements for participation must be met on the date of the deadline for the submission of applications and will be accredited by means of the CV attached to it, without prejudice to the power of the selection body to require the contribution of the originals of the certifications accrediting the qualifications, training and work experience invoked in the CV.

Applications that do not present the aforementioned or required documentation during the selection procedure will not be accepted.

Candidates must hold a PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Physics, or equivalent, and have hands-on experience in (S)TEM and/or synchrotron X-ray techniques.

Everyone who meets the requirements will be admitted for the selection process. This position is reserved for those candidates having the legal status of person with disabilities, with a degree of disability equal or greater than 33%. In case of one or more admitted applicants with this status of disability, these candidates will be evaluated at first. In the event that no candidate with the status of disability is finally selected for the position, the selection process shall continue and the rest of the applicants will be evaluated.

#### **Selection Process Development**

The selection will be carried out through the competition-opposition system.

As a first phase, an analysis of the curriculum will be carried out (assessment of previous experience and / or scientific history, degree, training and other professional information relevant to the position). Career breaks or variations in the chronological order of CVs will be regarded as an evolution of a career, and consequently, as a contribution to the professional development.

The assessment of the CV in the competition phase will be scored up to 40 points, which will consider the following aspects:

* Hands-on experience with in situ (S)TEM - up to 10 points.
* Hands-on experience with in situ synchrotron experiments - up to 10 points.
* Experience in developing and testing scientific instrumentation (reaction cells, gas delivery systems, illumination systems, strain cells...) – up to 10 pts.
* Scientific experience in x-ray/(S)TEM correlative experiments – up to 5 pts.
* Hands-on experience with advanced (S)TEM) techniques (e.g.: 4D-STEM, EDX/EELS, e-tomography, e-ptychography, …) and/or advanced correlative data analysis – up to 5 pts.

The best rated candidates, at least two if possible, will be invited to an interview where the technical competence, knowledge, skills and professional experience linked to the position will be assessed, with a total score of 60 points. A minimum of 30 points must be obtained out of a total of 60 points to be eligible.

Provided they meet the minimum requirements and have ranked among the top five after the assessment of the CV phase, at least one person from the underrepresented gender in the division/office will be interviewed.

The interview will include at least:

* Presentation of professional experience and capability to independently design and execute advanced scientific experiments - up to 20 points.
* Soft skills, capability to work in a team - up to 10 points.
* Capability to develop innovative methodologies - up to 10 points.
* Communication and coordination skills - up to 10 points.
* Vision of the job position and motivation for applying - up to 10 points.

The merits will be accredited by means of the CV attached to the application. The selection board may require accreditation by additional documentation, originals or certified copies confirming the experience invoked in the CV.

In case of a tied final score, the position will be awarded to the person who belongs to the most underrepresented gender in the corresponding Division and subsidiarily to the overall company.

If necessary, alternates of the members of the selection board will be appointed by the president of the selection process, and the change will be published in the announcement.

The resolution of the selection procedure will be carried out within a maximum period of six months from the deadline for submitting applications for participation.

The selection process may be declared vacant if the selection board considers not to have found eligible candidates for the position although they might meet the requirements to participate in the selection process specified in the offer.

#### **Other information**

Temporary contract linked to the HORIZON-INFRA-2022-TECH-01-01 IMPRESS project.

Base salary range €39,350 – €42,982 gross per year.

The base salary offered will be determined according to the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant professional experience, competencies and overall suitability for the position.

ALBA also offers an attractive employment conditions, including flexible working arrangements and professional development opportunities.

The Selection Board is composed by the following members: Núria Bagués Salguero, Antoni García de Herreros Dunyac, Joaquín Otón Pérez, Lucía Aballe Aramburu.

title: Tech Lead
description:
**About Board of Innovation**

BOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact. We help enterprise and scale-up clients move beyond experimentation by embedding AI directly into their operations, decision-making, and products. Our work spans industries, but always centers on production-ready AI, strong engineering, and real-world adoption.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Tech Lead to own the technical side of our most demanding AI builds, end to end. You step in the moment a client request lands, shape the scope and the solution with the team, turn it into an architecture and a build plan, lead the engineering through project delivery, and be the client's technical counterpart until the system runs in their environment.

This is a senior, on-project engineering role. Our builds typically run for several months, with three to five BOI engineers, inside the client's own cloud environment. You make the technical decisions within your projects, running one flagship build close to full-time or two or three smaller builds at once, depending on the portfolio. You report directly to our Engineering Director.

**What You'll Do**

You lead the technical delivery of enterprise AI builds, from agentic systems and LLM-powered services to the platforms around them, deployed into clients' own environments. The work runs in four strands.

Shape the solution. When a request lands on one of your accounts, you work out with the team what to build, how, with whom and in how many weeks. You write the technical side of the proposal and defend the estimate. Occasionally you do the same for a new deal, when a pitch needs an engineer who can credibly say how it will be built.

Lead the build. You own the architecture, make and document the decisions that shape it, review the team's work, and keep client stakeholders aligned on progress, trade-offs and risks. The engineers on the project look to you for direction, and you give it.

Build where it matters. When the critical path needs it, you build it yourself, whether that's a prototype that proves an approach in days, a hard integration, or a fix nobody else can land. What you ship is production-grade.

Carry the client. You're the technical voice in the room. You explain what we're building and why to people who don't write code, you earn their confidence that we can deliver, and you handle the realities of a large organization, from approvals and platform teams to security reviews and politics. You know when to push, when to work around, and when to escalate.

Between builds, you work on the internal tooling and templates that make every BOI engineer faster.

**What You Bring**

Experience. You have 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least two in which you technically led a build and the engineers on it, ideally for clients who were not technical themselves. You've taken systems from a design on paper to production in someone else's environment, and you know what that costs.

Applied AI depth. Your core strength is applied AI engineering, meaning agents, tool use, retrieval, MCP, evals and the orchestration around them. You've shipped LLM-based systems into production and have opinions about reliability, cost and evaluation that came from being burned. Our Engineering Director covers the deep ML side, so the best complement is someone whose instincts sit in systems, agents and delivery.

Engineering fundamentals. Python, CI/CD, testing, review discipline and infrastructure-as-code are second nature, and you use AI-assisted coding tools like Claude Code, Codex and MCP-based workflows fluently, with the guardrails that keep generated code production-grade. Real production cloud experience, Azure preferred, and experience deploying inside locked-down enterprise environments are a big plus.

Communication and judgement. You can explain an architecture to a VP in five minutes and hold a client room without a project manager running interference for you. You're creative in finding a path when the obvious one is blocked, you build trust fast, and you know what to decide yourself, what to flag, and when to escalate.

People management and hiring sit with the Engineering Director. You mentor the engineers on your projects, and the role can grow toward team-level leadership over time.

**How You Work**

You treat a build as yours. You make decisions and own them, keep the people who depend on you informed in writing, briefly and regularly, and ask for help early when the commercial or people side of a project needs it.

You're at home in a consulting environment, where each engagement brings a new domain, a new client culture and a new set of constraints, and you work in the open with strategists, designers and consultants.

The field moves quickly, and so do we. You pull in what's useful, bring it back to the team, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

**Contract & Setup**

You're based in Lisbon or elsewhere in Portugal, where our engineering team sits. We're open to permanent employment and long-term contractor arrangements, and the final setup depends on your situation and local compliance requirements. We'd like you to start in November 2026.

**Interested?**

Apply with your CV and a short note on a build you technically led, what went wrong, and what you'd do differently. Bonus points for something we can actually look at.

* Managing the creation of secure Digital Cinema Packages (DCPs) with timed text files (SMPTE/InterOP standards) that play flawlessly on theater screens worldwide.

**Engagement**

* Work closely with colleagues across the global organisation to identify and maximise all opportunities to meet objectives of the Global Revenue Strategy (GRS) through communications, external engagement and campaign execution.
* Identify, secure and manage relationships with third parties, including press and media, to support the strategy, particularly around the identification and acquisition of pro bono support from agencies and experts in Communications and Marketing.
* Ensure the effective flow of information across Departments and Supporter Country Offices so teams fully support others’ plans and priorities, the communication plans are understood and fully supported throughout the organisation, and the charity’s strategic plans, brand, ethics, and operations are understood by agencies and supporters.
* Effectively engage with internal teams, external partners, press contacts and stakeholders to maximise the impact of digital initiatives and stay informed about industry trends and best practices.
* Collaborate with colleagues from country offices to support the production of communications assets, ensuring alignment with organisational messaging and branding standards.

**Delivery**  
  
**Global External Engagement: 40%**

* Identify and execute thought leadership and media opportunities in support of WfWI’s Global Revenue Strategy, including developing content to pitch to media such as press releases, Op Eds and thought leadership pieces to amplify the impact of WfWI’s programs
* Manage and build media and influencer relations, including and active database across WfWI Supporter Country Offices and Regional hubs (Africa, SWANA, North America).
* Proactively identify Ambassadors and Champions in alignment with WfWI’s mission as well as support content development to engage existing celebrity Ambassadors and influencers.
* Monitor relevant conversations in the news
* Facilitate outreach campaigns and pitch/catch media inquiries
* Develop and manage events strategies and plans for the organization
* Develop thought leadership plans to raise visibility at external events, including participation of WfWI spokespersons in sector-specific events
* Work closely with colleagues from Country Offices and Regional Hubs to support external engagement activities and the production of communications assets (video, pictures, case studies).

**UK Communications Strategy, Planning and Editorial Content Development - 30%**

* Lead the production of editorial content for the Women for Women International’s UK website, blog, email and other owned channels, including content for campaigns, working closely with the Sr. Manager Global Brand & Communications
* Identify current trends and insight into emerging trends to prioritise opportunities for Women for Women International to position and communicate our work (across all content, audiences and channels) and realise opportunities to increase market reach and charitable impact.
* Responsible for first round of approvals for all press releases, email and print communications related to UK channels.
* Work closely with the Head of Marketing & Communications to develop project plans for fundraising and communications campaigns and a quarterly content strategy for Individual Giving fundraising.
* Lead on the production and delivery of compelling and impactful copy for Individual Giving fundraising acquisition and retention campaigns, including crisis response content.
* Support production and delivery of marketing emails via our email marketing platform (Marketing Cloud) and reporting on results (i.e. open rates, click throughs).
* Support the cultivation of supporters through targeted email journeys, including journey planning, content development and audience segmentation.

**Strategic Planning, Evaluation and Reporting - 10%**

* In partnership (support) with the Head of Marketing & Communications and Global Communications Director & External Relations, produce annual and three-year plans and budgets
* Support in the ongoing monitoring and reporting of KPIs to ensure we are meeting targets.
* Collaborate with the Finance team around expected expenditure and reforecasting.
* Manage and report on campaign budgets, prepare reports and updates for the Exec Team, and for the Head to present to the Board and Board committees as requested throughout the campaign period.
* Develop and own goals and performance metrics for media campaigns; monitor regularly to understand effectiveness of strategy and creative, making recommendations for continuous improvement

**Service Delivery - 10%**

* Manage collaboration with UK fundraising teams to deliver on all communications requirements for events and strengthen our Ambassador network and for grant-funders, major donors and corporate partners to exceed their expectations of communications support and ensure future funding:
* Develop and implement strategic communications plans for funders and corporate partners (where appropriate) who require visibility; work closely with our media consultant to identify press opportunities to support communications objectives.
* Ensure that our grant funders are visible and recognised across our website and social media channels (where appropriate).
* Feed into annual and quarterly reports for funders with a focus on communications objectives.
* Work with the Global Corporate Partnerships team to support on innovative ways to engage current and prospective brands in our communications, particularly around flagship campaigns like Women’s History Month.

**Line Management – 10%**

* Provide inspiring leadership to the Communications Officer, with regular and individualistic support, setting agreed objectives and supporting their delivery.
* Supervise the PR consultant to deliver agreed objectives around press coverage and PR services.

**Other**

* Be responsible for personal learning and development and participate in supervision, training, and meetings as required.
* Ensure that you are up to date with, and well informed of, sector developments and competitor activity to inform our strategies and ensure our campaigns are cutting edge and innovative, as well as being sector best practice and within the specific legal framework of the territory of operation.
* Undertake any other duties appropriate to the post as required.
* Travel three to four times a year for up to one week at a time; no travel to country programme offices/high risk locations required.

  

### **Skills Knowledge and Expertise**

**Person specification**

The criteria marked **A** will be assessed at the Application stage  
  
**Required**

* Existing and ongoing right to work in the UK and the ability to maintain without sponsorship by Women for Women International. A
* Passion for social Issues: Genuine passion for global issues, women's empowerment, human rights, and a keen interest in understanding corporate partners' industries and their potential alignment with the organization's mission. A
* Pitching Experience crafting pitches to media and converting them to earned media coverage A
* PR and media relations Experience working in PR and media relations, with expertise in cultivating media relationships across US and the UK as well as has existing contacts in top tier outlets like The Guardian, BBC, NPR etc. A
* Email marketing expertise: Proficiency in managing email marketing campaigns, including creating marketing emails in platforms like Marketing Cloud, creating donor journeys and analyzing performance metrics to optimise engagement. A
* Event management experience: Experience managing events including logistics and event planning, including concepting events such as panel discussions, roundtables, fundraiser salons etc. A
* Management: Experience of being responsible for this function and holding the role of manager with experience of managing, developing and inspiring staff with confidence, compassion and a passion for personal development A
* Effective communication: Excellent written and oral communication, capable of inspiring and motivating others. Skilled in composing, editing, and proofreading fundraising and marketing materials across various channels.
* IT Proficiency: Strong computer skills, including experience with software such as PowerPoint, Word, Teams and Content Management Systems (e.g. Drupal), Email Marketing tools
* Editorial content strategy: Experience in crafting editorial content strategies and copywriting for websites, blogs, with a focus on aligning content with organizational objectives and key external events.
* Stakeholder management: Demonstrated track record of building and managing successful relationships with diverse internal and external global stakeholders and working with global teams across geographies and cultures.
* Organisational skills: Strong ability to prioritise tasks with attention to detail, maintaining accuracy even under pressure.
* Ability to work under pressure: Calm under pressure, proficient at multitasking, and managing projects within tight deadlines and small budgets.
* Decision-making skills: Capable of making and implementing logical decisions effectively.
* Flexibility and adaptability: Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, adapting to changing priorities and requirements while maintaining a solutions-oriented approach.
* Travel Able to travel up to four times a year for up to one week at a time.

***Preferred***

* **Cross-channel content planning**: Experience in developing and executing cross-channel content plans, ensuring consistency and coherence across various communication platforms.
* **Supporter journey mapping:** Familiarity with supporter journey mapping and the ability to develop strategic content plans to engage and retain individual donors throughout their journey.
* **Funder communications management**: Understanding of funder communications requirements and strategies, including the ability to develop and implement strategic communication plans to meet funders' visibility and reporting expectations.
* **International development knowledge:** Knowledge of international development policies, women's rights issues, and women's experiences in conflict-affected countries, enabling informed decision-making and content development.
* **Entrepreneurial mindset:** Creative and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to identify and act on opportunities to maximise the organisation's reach and impact.
* **Cultural sensitivity:** Strong interpersonal skills and cultural sensitivity, allowing for effective communication and relationship-building with stakeholders from diverse backgrounds and cultures.

### **Benefits**

What we offer all of our employees:

* Your work-life balance is important to us, and we offer all our staff the option to work **70 hours over 9 working** days and have **every other Friday off** where possible.
* We offer **25 days annual leave** increasing by **1 day per year up to a maximum of 30 days**, plus bank holidays.
* It is essential to save for your retirement. All eligible employees are will be auto-enrolled in our **group pension plan with a minimum employee contribution of 3% and an employer contribution from 5%.**
* We work on a **hybrid basis**, and you will be set up to work from home and have the option to work from our office in Bermondsey whenever you want to. We enjoy being in the office a day or two a week to meet colleagues face to face.
* Your **health and wellbeing** is important to us and we provide a free confidential **Employee Assistance Programme** to help you deal with personal and professional problems that could be impacting your home life or work life.

**This role is be based in the UK, please note Women for Women International does not offer sponsorship for potential candidates.**

  

### **About Women for Women International**

**Background**  
Women for Women International invests where inequality is greatest by helping women who are forgotten — the women survivors of war and conflict.

In Afghanistan, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Iraq, Kosovo, Nigeria, Rwanda, and South Sudan, women learn skills to rebuild their families and communities through the Women for Women International’s Stronger Women, Stronger Nations Programme.

They form support networks, are equipped with the skills to earn an income and save and gain knowledge and resources about health and their rights. Since 1993, our global community has invested in the power of over 550,000 women across 17 conflict-affected countries, to create a ripple effect that makes the world more equal, peaceful, and prosperous.  
  
Diversity at Women for Women International is about inclusion, embracing differences, creating possibilities and growing together for better performance. We embrace diversity in our workforce. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, political opinions, and pregnancy and maternity. Applications are welcomed and encouraged from all interested parties.

All our staff are required to adhere to WfWI’s Code of Conduct and Safeguarding policies and to our organizational values: Empowerment, Integrity, Respect, Resilience and the Leadership Principles: Decisive, Accountable, Courageous, Adaptable and Inclusive.

**Research Assistant (ELPCEC Evaluation)**

East London Primary Care Education Centre (ELPCEC)
  
Centre for Health Equity and Sustainable Societies (CHESS)
  
University of East London

Grade: E (point scale 29)
  
Contract: Fixed Term – 18 months, 0.5 FTE (part-time, approximately 21 hours per week)

Location: Stratford campus, University of East London (with community outreach across east London)

The University of East London (UEL) is a careers-led, forward-thinking institution committed to making a positive impact on students, graduates and the communities it serves. As one of the most diverse universities in London, UEL is proud to conduct research that addresses real-world challenges and informs policy at national and international levels.

We are seeking a highly motivated Research Assistant to join the Centre for Health Equity and Sustainable Societies (CHESS) Evaluation Unit, within the Institute for Connected Communities. The Evaluation Unit conducts applied research at the intersection of health, education and community wellbeing, leading rigorous, participatory evaluations of complex programmes that generate evidence which is actionable, equitable and grounded in lived experience.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the evaluation of the East London Primary Care Education Centre (ELPCEC), an 18-month pilot programme bringing together education, health and skills pathways for young people who are NEET, neurodiverse or facing multiple disadvantages. The post holder will work closely with Dr Darren Sharpe, Director of CHESS, and the wider programme team, engaging directly with young people, partner organisations and community settings across east London.

Key Responsibilities Include:

* Supporting the design and delivery of a participatory evaluation framework, including developing accessible surveys, interviewguidesand creative research tools
* Recruiting,trainingand supporting young people to act as co-researchers, andfacilitatingcreative and participatory research activities
* Supporting qualitative and quantitative data collection and analysis, including thematic analysis and review of monitoring data
* Managing participant data,anonymisationand secure data storage in line with GDPR
* Drafting research documentation such as participant information sheets, consent forms and topic guides for young people and vulnerable groups
* Supporting safeguarding protocols and risk assessment procedures throughout all research activity
* Preparing evaluation briefings, reports and policy-relevant outputs, and contributing to peer-reviewed publications
* Liaising with partner organisations, schools and community organisations across Newham,Hackneyand Tower Hamlets

The right candidate will have a background in youth work and direct experience of participatory and creative research methods, along with existing knowledge of, and relationships within, youth-facing work in north or east London.

Due to the involvement of young people and vulnerable groups in the research, the successful candidate will be subject to an Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check.

**Interviews will be held remotely via Microsoft Teams.**

title: Director of Technology & AI
description:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY

321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.

Technology isn't a support function at 321 — it's the foundation everything else runs on. Our CRM builds, paid media measurement, AI workflows, and client reporting all depend on systems that are well-architected, secure, and connected. The Director of Technology is the leader who makes that foundation work as one.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Technology at 321, you will lead the agency's technology function across internal systems, MarTech and CRM infrastructure, data and integrations, AI enablement, and information security. This is a senior leadership role with real strategic authority — you'll own the agency's technology roadmap, set standards for how our platforms are built and governed, and serve as the senior technical voice in client strategy, new business, and agency planning conversations.

The right person for this role thinks in systems, not tools. You understand that a CRM workflow is only as reliable as the integration feeding it, that clean data is the difference between real attribution and guesswork, and that AI only creates leverage when it's built into the way a team actually works. You're as comfortable reviewing a webhook payload or a High Level workflow as you are presenting a technology roadmap to agency leadership — and you lead a team that delivers both.

You'll also work in close coordination with 321 AIM, the agency's proprietary performance marketing platform, ensuring that its technology, data flows, and integrations stay aligned with the systems that power our client programs.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

**Technology Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, manage, and grow the Technology department, including CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration
* Own the agency's technology roadmap, aligning platform investments with client delivery needs, agency growth goals, and operational efficiency
* Set the department's operating model: build standards, QA and testing practices, documentation requirements, change management, and support processes
* Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews; provide technical coaching and actively develop team capabilities
* Define role scopes, skill development paths, and staffing recommendations as the department grows to warrant additional headcount
* Serve as the escalation point for system outages, integration failures, data issues, and complex technical questions across the client portfolio

**Agency Systems, Infrastructure & Security**

* Own the agency's internal technology stack, including collaboration, project management, identity, file storage, and communication tools
* Manage user access, single sign-on, device policies, and account provisioning and offboarding for a fully remote team
* Establish and enforce information security policies, password and access standards, backup practices, and incident response procedures
* Ensure agency and client systems meet applicable privacy and compliance requirements, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
* Manage technology vendors, licenses, contracts, and costs; evaluate build-versus-buy decisions

**MarTech, CRM & Integration Architecture**

* Set architecture and governance standards for client CRM and marketing automation programs built primarily on High Level, with additional work in Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and HubSpot
* Oversee integrations between CRMs, ad platforms, websites, call tracking, payment processors, and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and middleware such as Zapier, Make, or n8n
* Standardize snapshots, templates, naming conventions, tagging, and data hygiene practices across client accounts
* Lead technical discovery for new client onboarding and CRM migrations, including data mapping, cleansing, and cutover planning
* Review complex builds for scalability, reliability, and maintainability before launch

**AI Enablement & Automation**

* Champion the integration of AI across the agency — from internal operations and reporting to CRM personalization, conversational AI, and workflow automation
* Evaluate, pilot, and roll out AI tools and LLM-powered solutions, with clear standards for data privacy, accuracy, and appropriate use
* Build and maintain internal automations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and improve delivery quality
* Stay current on emerging AI and MarTech capabilities and proactively introduce relevant innovations to the agency and its clients

**Data, Analytics & Measurement Infrastructure**

* Own the agency's data and measurement infrastructure, including conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
* Partner with the Director of Digital Marketing to ensure lead source tracking, cost-per-lead reporting, and audience syndication between CRMs and ad platforms work reliably
* Build and maintain data pipelines and reporting infrastructure that feed client dashboards in Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar tools
* Establish data quality standards and monitoring across connected systems

**Client Engagement & Agency Growth**

* Serve as the senior technology authority in client strategy sessions, QBRs, and new business pitches — translating technical solutions into clear, business-outcome terms
* Contribute technology recommendations, solution architecture, and implementation estimates to agency proposals and RFP responses
* Partner with 321 AIM on shared clients and platform needs to ensure technology, data flows, and lead infrastructure are coordinated and mutually reinforcing
* Identify opportunities to productize repeatable technology solutions into new agency service offerings

WHAT YOU HAVE

* 8+ years of experience in technology, MarTech, or systems roles, with demonstrated depth in CRM architecture, integrations, and data infrastructure — agency experience strongly preferred
* At least 2–3 years in a department leadership, team lead, or senior manager role with direct reports
* Hands-on experience architecting and governing CRM and marketing automation programs in High Level is strongly preferred; Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and/or HubSpot experience also valued
* Deep experience with APIs, webhooks, and middleware (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar), including troubleshooting integrations across multiple systems
* Strong command of conversion tracking and measurement infrastructure: Google Tag Manager, GA4, server-side tracking, and offline conversion imports
* Working knowledge of data pipelines, data warehousing, and reporting tools (BigQuery, Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar)
* Experience administering cloud-based business systems, identity and access management, and security for a remote team
* Working knowledge of privacy and compliance requirements affecting marketing technology in regulated industries, including HIPAA, TCPA, A2P 10DLC, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
* Practical experience deploying AI tools and LLM-powered workflows, with sound judgment on data privacy and appropriate use
* Scripting or development ability in JavaScript, Python, SQL, or similar is a strong plus
* Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to clients, agency leadership, and non-technical teammates
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage department operations across a remote, multi-client environment
* Platform certifications (High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, cloud or security certifications) are a plus
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience

REPORTING STRUCTURE

The Director of Technology reports directly to the SVP of Strategy and is a member of the agency's leadership team. This role directly manages the Technology department, encompassing CRM/MarTech engineers, integration specialists, and systems administration. The Director of Technology maintains a working relationship with 321 AIM leadership to align platform technology and data infrastructure, and collaborates closely with the Director of Digital Marketing, Director of Client Strategy, and Creative Director on integrated account delivery.

COMPENSATION

Salary Range: $100K+ annually, based on experience

321 uses a structured compensation framework aligned to role scope, department impact, and agency revenue contribution. Salary placement within range is based on demonstrated experience, leadership depth, and technical breadth across CRM, integrations, data, and AI. Performance bonus eligibility applies at the director level.

321 BENEFITS

* 100% remote work environment
* Flexible scheduling with core collaboration hours
* Paid time off + agency-observed holidays
* Professional development and platform/tool access budget
* Collaborative, AI-forward team culture that values innovation and continuous learning
* Opportunity to build and lead the technology foundation of a high-growth agency operating at the intersection of performance marketing and marketing technology

What this role is: A role for a visual storyteller and creative thinker who can develop the strategy and personally execute the work.

What this role is not: A people management or high-level strategy-only role.

Key responsibilities

Social strategy and execution

* Own organic social media strategy and execution across Fairfax Fertility brands, translating broader brand and business strategies into distinct, compelling social presences.
* Define how each brand shows up on social, developing clear points of view, content approaches, tone, and storytelling strategies tailored to each platform and audience.
* Own social content calendars across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and LinkedIn, balancing planned campaigns, educational content, brand storytelling, community engagement, and timelyopportunities.
