* Develop platform-native concepts designed specifically for how audiences consume and engage with content on each channel rather than simply adapting the same content across platforms.
* Write compelling social copy and develop concepts for short-form video, carousels, graphics, interviews, educational series, donor and family storytelling, and other emerging formats.
* Lead the evolution of brand voice and storytelling on social, ensuring content feels human, relevant, recognizable, and consistent while remaining distinct across brands and audiences.
* Identify opportunities to bring scientific, clinical, educational, and human-interest stories to life through accessible and engaging social-first content.
* Proactively identify cultural moments, trends, conversations, formats, and platform opportunities that are relevant to our audiences and determine when and how the brands should participate.
* Own community engagement, helping establish how the brands interact with followers, respond to conversations, and build meaningful relationships with their audiences.
* Own channel- and audience-specific KPIs and reporting, analyzing reach, engagement, audience growth, traffic, conversion, and content performance to understand what is driving results.
* Establish a continuous test-and-learn approach across formats, creative concepts, messaging, cadence, hooks, calls to action, and platform-specific tactics, using performance insights to continually evolve the social strategy.
* Stay deeply current on platform changes, emerging formats, social behaviors, and best practices, proactively bringing new ideas and recommendations to the broader marketing team

Influencer, UGC, and community storytelling

* Own influencer, UGC, and community storytelling strategy across Fairfax Fertility brands, building programs that bring authentic voices and real experiences into our content ecosystem.
* Develop and manage influencer and creator partnerships from identification and outreach through briefing, content development, approvals, publishing, and performance measurement.
* Build a scalable UGC program, identifying opportunities to source, commission, and repurpose creator-led content across organic social, paid media, lifecycle communications, websites, and other marketing channels.
* Own the donor community testimonial and storytelling program, proactively identifying and cultivating donors who are willing to share their experiences through testimonials, interviews, social content, video, and longer-form stories.
* Build ongoing relationships with participating donors and community members, creating a thoughtful experience that encourages authentic storytelling and continued brand advocacy.
* Interview donors and creators to uncover compelling stories and translate their experiences into content concepts that feel authentic, emotionally resonant, and aligned with brand strategy.
* Develop creative briefs, interview guides, talking points, and content direction that give creators and community participants clear guidance while preserving their individual voices and experiences.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to manage appropriate permissions, releases, reviews, and approvals for influencer, UGC, testimonial, and community-generated content.

* Establish KPIs and reporting for influencer, UGC, and community storytelling initiatives, using performance insights to refine partnerships, content formats, and future programming.

Planning, operations and collaboration

* Expertly plan and manage multiple brands, channels, audiences, and content priorities simultaneously, balancing short- and long-term needs while proactively identifying gaps, conflicts, and opportunities.

title: Head of Field and Partner Marketing
description:

### **Role Description**

Dropbox is hiring a **Head of Field & Partner Marketing** to lead our global field and partner marketing organization and drive pipeline growth across our **Sales-Led Growth****(SLG)** business and strategic partner ecosystem.

This executive Go-To-Market (GTM) leader will own the regional marketing strategy, account-based execution, mid-to-bottom funnel demand engines, and partner marketing required to scale business-to-business revenue globally. While our PLG team focuses on the frictionless, self-serve transactional customer lifecycle, this leader owns the end-to-end marketing journey for sales-engaged and partner-led motions.

This role requires an exceptional strategic operator who can orchestrate targeted account-based marketing (ABM) and regional demand generation alongside localized partner programs—including managing co-marketing initiatives with strategic AI technology ecosystems (ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini) and supporting our distribution networks. Partnering closely with regional Sales and Channel leaders, this executive will oversee integrated campaigns, joint partner value propositions, content strategies, and comprehensive PLG to SLG customer lifecycle initiatives.

### **Responsibilities**

* **SLG & Partner Pipeline Accountability:** Own the strategic vision and performance metrics (creation, coverage, and acceleration) for both direct field pipeline and indirect partner-led business globally.
* **Integrated Demand Generation:** Lead the Integrated Marketing team to design and deploy highly optimized mid- and bottom-funnel acquisition campaigns that move prospects effectively through the sales pipeline.
* **Content & Customer Campaigns:** Oversee the upstream Campaigns team to deliver compelling content frameworks and high-impact customer marketing initiatives that drive post-sale engagement, adoption, brand advocacy, and net revenue retention (NRR).
* **Partner Alliance & Co-Marketing:** Develop and execute high-impact joint marketing programs with strategic AI and productivity ecosystem partners (including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini). Build compelling value propositions that position Dropbox as the core content layer for modern workflows.
* **Distribution & Channel Support:** Oversee marketing strategies to and through Dropbox’s distribution networks and cloud marketplaces to support our incremental channel revenue stream.
* **Account-Based Marketing****(ABM)** **Strategy:** Build, scale, and institutionalize Dropbox’s ABM framework. Define account selection, tiering, multi-channel orchestration, and tailored campaigns for high-value corporate and mid-market accounts.
* **PLG-to-SLG Monetization:** Partner closely with the PLG Digital Marketing and Product teams to identify accounts with high existing self-serve usage, triggering targeted field and partner campaigns to convert them into larger team or corporate agreements.
* **Sales & Partner Architecture Interlock:** Establish trusted partnerships with regional Sales VPs and the Alliance organization to align on territory strategies, partner incentives, target account lists, and quarterly outbound cadences.
* **Experiential & Executive Engagement:** Oversee the global portfolio of regional field events, proprietary customer advisory boards (CABs), executive roundtable programs, and major industry tech activations.
* **Team Leadership & Org Design:** Manage, mentor, and scale a multi-disciplinary, globally distributed team spanning four core functions: **Integrated Marketing** (mid/bottom funnel demand), **Regional Field Marketing**, **Partner/Channel Marketing**, and **Campaigns** (Content & Customer Marketing). Foster a high-performance culture tied directly to pipeline health and business outcomes.

### **Requirements**

* **10+ years** of B2B marketing experience with increasing leadership responsibility spanning field marketing, partner/channel marketing, and demand generation.
* **5+ years** of experience leading, scaling, and managing multi-disciplinary marketing teams, including direct oversight of demand generation, content/creative production, or customer marketing functions.
* **Ecosystem & Tech Alliance Experience:** Proven track record of managing joint marketing programs with major technology platforms, SaaS alliances, or AI ecosystems.
* **Sales Alignment:** Experience partnering directly with Sales VPs, directors, and external partner leadership in a multi-tiered GTM environment.
* **B2B Funnel Mastery:** Deep understanding of multi-month B2B sales cycles, buying committees, account progression, and revenue attribution models.
* **Data-Driven Mindset:** Strong analytical orientation with hands-on experience using pipeline metrics, win rates, funnel velocity, and ROI modeling to drive investment decisions.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Hybrid GTM Experience:** Proven success working within a hybrid B2B model, specifically leveraging product-led metrics (PQLs, active usage) to fuel sales pipelines and partner co-selling.
* **Global Scale:** Experience supporting multi-region sales and partner organizations, with a strong ability to balance global consistency with local market nuances.
* **MarTech/SalesTech Fluency:** Familiarity with modern business tech stacks (PRM/Partner Relationship Management systems, CRM, MAP, and ABM/intent data platforms).
* **AI & Cloud Market Fluency:** Strong understanding of the modern AI landscape, developer tool ecosystems, and cloud productivity paradigms.
* **Executive Presence:** Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently command attention and influence internal leadership and external clients/partners.

### **Durable Skills**

AI fluency means using these tools to *amplify* human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

* **Awareness:** Understand yourself and others.
* **Judgment:** Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
* **Adaptability:** Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
* **Connection:** Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

title: Head of Marketing, B2B Payments
description:
**About Rebill**
Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.
  
  
The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.
  
  
Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.
  
  
Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.
  
  
Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.
  
  
Built locally. Designed to scale globally.
  
  
Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).
  
  
Why this role exists
  
  
Our product is ahead of our brand.
  
  
We show up in evaluations against the large regional processors. In too many of them we are not in the room at all, and in the ones where we are, we read as earlier stage than we are. A company about to route its regional volume through us needs to see infrastructure, not a startup. That gap costs us deals we should be winning on product.
  
  
At the same time, every piece of marketing we do today is run by the founders in the gaps between other jobs: the ads, the SEO, the content, the launches, the events. It holds at twelve people. It will not hold through the next stage.
  
  
This role owns both.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Brand and positioning. One story about what Rebill is and why it matters, decided once and held everywhere: the site, the deck, the product, the sales calls. There are four versions of it today. The harder half of this is moving Rebill from looking like a startup to being credible to a bank, a public company or a regulated buyer, and doing it without losing the reason people like working with us. Visual identity and the standard of every surface that carries our name are part of the job.
* Product marketing. Our product is technical and our buyer gets more sophisticated every quarter. Someone has to turn what engineering ships into something a CFO or a VP of Finance understands and acts on: launches with a real process behind them, sales material that shortens a cycle instead of decorating it, and airtime for the people building it.
* Content and distribution. Build the publishing engine: site, blog, LinkedIn, press, and the organic surface that AI assistants cite when someone asks how to collect across Latin America. Content goes out in English first and gets localized per market after.
* Events and founder positioning. Own the calendar and the outcome, from Money20/20 and Febraban class shows down to dinners for fifteen people that move one account. Booth, content, capture, follow-up, and the discipline of cross-referencing scanned leads against the CRM so we know what was net new and which opportunities we influenced. The bar is that events pay for themselves and that you can show it. You will also get our founders onto the right stages and make them better once they are up there.
* Demand generation. Campaigns, paid, funnel instrumentation and the loop back to sales. You inherit what the founders run today, starting with Google Ads and SEO.
* Ecosystem. Accelerators, communities, partner co-marketing and the Y Combinator network.

**What We Are Looking For**

* You work inside a technology company today, or did until recently, and someone else paid for that learning curve. Rebill is not where you find out how software gets built and sold. Payments or fintech in Latin America is where our strongest candidates come from. Failing that, a technical B2B category with a sophisticated buyer and a long sales cycle. If your career is in agencies, consulting or consumer brands, this is not the role.
* You have sold to companies, not consumers. You know what a long enterprise cycle feels like from the inside and what actually counts as proof inside one.
* You have run marketing across several countries from one seat. Not one market with regional support. Several markets with different payment cultures, different press and different buyers, with a team you could count on one hand.
* Your career passed through more than one discipline. The people who are best at this job have some combination of classical brand work, where owning a brand meant owning a business, hands-on paid media, and time spent close to product. One lane is not enough here. Two or three is what makes the difference.
* You are hands-on. You write the copy, brief the designer, build the deck and pull the numbers yourself. For the first stretch there is nobody to hand it to.
* You write English at a level that does not need editing, and you present in English and Spanish. Our content is English first.

You use AI tools every day and it is visible in how much you ship and how good it is.
  
  
**Nice to have**

* Portuguese. Brazil is a priority market and we invest there.
* You have taken a company through the move from looking like a startup to being credible to a regulated buyer, and you remember what actually shifted it.
* Press and analyst relations in payments or fintech.
* Ownership of a booth or a program at an event the size of Money20/20 or Febraban.
* You have managed a designer or an agency and held visual consistency across markets.
* A real network in the Latin American fintech ecosystem: accelerators, communities, funds, operators.

**What Success Looks Like**
In the first 90 days there is one version of our story and everyone uses it. The site, the deck and the sales team say the same thing, and you can explain in one paragraph why a company should route its regional volume through us.
  
  
By six months there is a content engine publishing in English with a localization path, launches have a process attached to them, and our events are measured against pipeline instead of against how the booth felt.
  
  
By twelve months, when a mid-market or enterprise company in the Americas starts looking for a way to collect across the region, we are on the shortlist. Marketing sources a measurable share of new pipeline and you know which share and why.
  
  
**What This Role Is Not**
There is no team to inherit. You are the marketing function for the first stretch, and you hire in the second year, not the first.
  
  
The founders stay the public faces of Rebill. We want you to make us better at that and to build a brand that outlasts us doing it. We are not looking for someone to be the voice instead of us.
  
  
We keep marketing in-house. We use agencies for specific pieces, press and visual identity among them, and we do not hand anyone the brand.
  
  
You report to the co-founders, and you will spend your first months earning credibility with people who have never worked alongside a marketing function. That is part of the job and not a sign that it is going badly.
  
  
**Compensation**
Competitive base, meaningful equity, and the scope of a founding function. Hybrid in Buenos Aires, Bogotá or Miami. Remote from Mexico City or São Paulo, with regular time in one of our offices. Travel for events and offsites.

**Education and Experience**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred

OR

title: Head of Video
description:
**We're hiring: Head of Video – Ramos Real Estate Dubai**

Lead the visual identity of a growing real estate and property tech group.

For four years, Ramos Real Estate has helped clients invest in Dubai property, with a strong focus on off-plan projects and international buyers, especially from Nigeria. We're growing fast alongside our sister company, Expert Listing, a property platform built for Nigeria.

We're looking for a talented video editor and shooter to own our content from idea to final cut. This isn't a "shoot what you're told" role. You'll shape how our brand looks, sounds and feels across every platform.

**What you'll own**

* Our video style and direction across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook
* Shooting property tours, off-plan launches, show units, drone and lifestyle footage across Dubai
* Editing high-quality short-form and long-form videos, including faceless content with voice-overs, motion graphics and captions
* A monthly plan of 20+ finished videos, created with our marketing team
* Tracking what performs and using the data to improve each month's content

**What success looks like**

* 20+ finished videos delivered every month
* Edits turned around within 48 hours of a shoot
* Content that grows our reach, engagement and buyer enquiries month on month

**What we're looking for**

* A strong showreel with real estate, luxury, architecture or lifestyle content
* Advanced editing skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut
* Confidence shooting with mirrorless cameras, gimbals and audio equipment
* A sharp eye for storytelling, pacing and social media trends
* Ability to work independently and deliver on time
* Based in Dubai

**What we offer**

* Salary: AED 5,000–7,000 per month, depending on experience
* Monthly performance bonus for hitting delivery and results targets
* Bonus when a lead from your content turns into a closed sale
* Guaranteed salary review after 3 months
* Creative freedom to define the brand's visual style
* Flexible working: edit remotely between shoots
* Camera, gimbal and audio kit provided
* A clear path to lead content across two growing companies

**How to apply**

Send your CV and portfolio or showreel to info@ramosrealestatedubai.com with the subject line "Head of Video – [Your Name]."

In your email, include a short note describing one real estate video you'd create for us.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test edit, and we aim to make a decision within one week. Applications without a CV, portfolio and video idea won't be considered.

title: Fractional Media Director
description:
**Overview**

We are seeking an autonomous, business-minded **Media Director** to take comprehensive ownership of our annual **$20M media budget**. As a $200-$250M omnichannel brand scaling rapidly, we are moving beyond pure-play performance to build a sophisticated, full-funnel media engine.

In this role, you will operate as a high-leverage individual contributor. Instead of managing a large internal team, you will wield full strategic control over media allocation and agency partners. You will be responsible for balancing traditional **DTC conversion media**, deploying our new **brand awareness initiatives**, and maximizing our presence across our core Retail Media Networks: **Amazon** and **Target**. Additionally, you will support us in hiring the right media agency/partner.

**Duties**

**1. Full Media Budget Ownership & Capital Allocation**

* Serve as the sole financial steward for the $XM media budget, fluidly shifting capital between performance, brand, and retail channels to maximize overall enterprise growth.
* Lead comprehensive media planning and scenario-modeling to present direct spending recommendations to executive leadership.

**2. Retail Media Network (RMN) Mastery (Amazon & Target)**

* Drive omni-channel velocity by building and scaling ad strategies on **Amazon Advertising** (Sponsored Ads, DSP) and **Target Roundel**.
* Align digital media plans with retail trade calendars to ensure digital media spend directly boosts physical shelf velocity and online market share.

**3. Full-Funnel Brand Awareness Strategy**

* Own the strategy, deployment, and optimization of upper-funnel brand equity campaigns across Connected TV (CTV), Digital Audio, Linear, and Programmatic video.
* Establish and track upper-funnel success metrics via brand lift studies, tracking share of voice (SOV), and baseline organic search growth.

**4. DTC Conversion & Performance Media**

* Maintain the efficiency of core performance channels (Meta, Google, TikTok) focusing on Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), and Blended Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER). Recognizing this is the core of media planning and strategy today, this will be a strong foundation shift.
* Partner with internal creative teams to guide rapid asset testing based on performance data trends.

**5. High-Impact Agency Governance**

* Directly manage external media planning, buying, and performance agencies, acting as their primary point of contact and holding them to strict execution standards.
* Audit agency work continuously to eliminate media waste and ensure data-driven campaign optimizations.

**6. Advanced Attribution & Holistic Measurement**

* Partner with Data Analytics to interpret Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) readouts.
* Quantify the "halo effect" of brand and retail media spending on our direct-to-consumer website traffic and sales.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience overseeing omnichannel media strategy, either brand-side or at a leading growth agency.
* **Budget Scale:** Direct experience managing or heavily influencing media budgets of **$20M+ annually**.
* **RMN Specialization:** Proven, deep expertise navigating **Amazon Advertising** and **Target Roundel** ecosystems.
* **Individual Contributor DNA:** Thrives as a self-directed operator who can command a $50M budget and steer agencies without needing a large internal team to delegate to.
* **Full-Funnel Native:** Demonstrated success deploying and measuring upper-funnel, non-linear brand awareness campaigns.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Highly proficient in interpreting MMM data, Google Analytics 4, and multi-retailer dashboard metrics.

Join us as a Fractional Media Director if you're ready to bring your strategic vision to life through impactful storytelling, innovative media outreach, and engaging digital campaigns!

Work Location: Remote

title: Associate Resource Director, Creative

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is building Flow, a unified data security platform spanning Human Data Security, Agentic Data Security, and Data Security Posture Management. The people who use it are security analysts, insider-risk investigators, and data protection leaders — experts doing demanding work under time pressure, who live in our product all day. And increasingly they are not working alone: AI agents are becoming actors inside the enterprise and inside our product, which means the experience we design now has to serve both the human doing the judging and the agent doing the work.

We are looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and own what Flow feels like to use. You will set the experience vision for the platform, define the interaction patterns for a generation of security work that is part human and part agentic, and lead the designers and researchers who make it real.

You will lead a small, talented team of designers and will partner directly with the CPO, product management, engineering, and customer experience, and you will operate as the design voice in the rooms where the roadmap and scope get decided. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will raise the craft bar and grow your team, and still be close enough to the work to have an independent point of view about what we should build.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end product design experience across Flow, HDS, ADS, and DSPM from the analyst’s daily workflow to how the platform holds together as one product rather than three.
* Define the next-generation experience vision for the platform, including how humans and AI agents work together inside it: agent-assisted investigation, human-in-the-loop decisions, explainability, and the interaction patterns that let a security professional trust and override automated work.
* Lead, coach, and grow a team of product designers, and raise the standard for craft, critique, and how design decisions are argued and defended.
* Own the UX research function and make sure the team’s work is grounded in evidence customer interviews, usability testing, support and RFE signal, and product instrumentation rather than internal opinion.
* Partner with product management and engineering from the earliest stage of every major initiative, shaping the problem definition and scope rather than styling decisions that have already been made.
* Build and evolve the design system and the patterns that let a growing engineering organization ship a consistent experience at speed.
* Establish how design measures itself usability benchmarks, task success, time to resolution for core analyst workflows, adoption of new surfaces, support deflection and report against it.
* Drive the experience work behind platform migration, making sure the move to Flow is something customers want rather than something they endure.
* Represent the customer’s experience in executive forums roadmap reviews, business reviews, and planning with a clear and honest read on where the product stands.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, including 4+ years leading and developing designers, with a portfolio of shipped work you can walk through end to end.
* You have set an experience vision for a complex product and then delivered against it — not just a concept deck, but patterns and surfaces that shipped and held up.
* Experienced with complex, expert-user enterprise software — tools where the user is a professional doing demanding work, not a consumer. Security, IT operations, observability, data infrastructure, or similar domains.
* You have designed AI-powered or agentic product experiences and have a real point of view on trust, transparency, control, and what happens when the model is wrong.
* Strong systems thinker: you can hold a platform-level information architecture in your head, and you build design systems that make teams faster instead of slowing them down.
* You value and use research. You know how to run the function, ask the right questions of it, and act on what comes back.
* An exceptional communicator and influencer. You can tell a room of executives something they do not want to hear, ground it in the customer’s reality, and leave with a decision.
* A people leader first. You develop designers, give direct feedback, and build a team that does its best work.
* You operate with urgency and judgment in a fast-moving environment, and you are comfortable making progress before every input is in hand.
* Located in the US (SF Bay Area preferred).

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Worked in cybersecurity, or designed for security operations, insider risk, or data protection teams.
* Led design through a major platform migration or the consolidation of several products into one.
* Experience building a design function hiring, leveling, process, and the operating rhythm not just running one that already existed.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.  
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

**AI Tools Disclosure:** As part of Cyberhaven's hiring process, we use recruiting tools that include AI-powered features to help with tasks like scheduling, note-taking, workflow automation, and other recruiting activities ("AI Tools"). The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

*Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

Compensation Range: $250K - $275K

Electric Pen is looking for a Graphic Designer with proven presentation design skills, and the range to take on a broad mix of project types.

Presentation work carries significant weight in this role. You will turn complex information into clear, compelling visual stories for executive audiences, client communications, keynotes, industry conferences, and leadership summits. You will also be expected to contribute across branding, marketing, and other visual design work as the studio needs it.

Great presentation design is more than making slides look good. You will help shape information into thoughtful visual narratives that engage an audience, support a strategic goal, and reflect our promise: dramatic results without the drama.

Culture fit matters here as much as talent and experience. We are looking for someone who is kind, accountable, collaborative, and steady when the work gets busy.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and produce polished, high-quality presentations, primarily in PowerPoint.
* Transform complex, technical, or abstract information into clear and compelling visual stories.
* Take on a broad range of design projects beyond presentations, including brand, marketing, and other visual work.
* Collaborate with creative and account teams to develop design approaches that communicate the client’s message.
* Create materials for executive audiences, keynote events, conferences, leadership meetings, and other high-visibility settings.
* Work with clients, senior stakeholders, speakers, and event teams on cohesive visual narratives and presentation frameworks.
* Ensure designs align with client brand standards, objectives, and expectations.
* Adapt presentations for live, virtual, and hybrid environments.
* Contribute to presentation design processes, templates, and standards.
* Stay current on presentation design trends, tools, and best practices.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Proven presentation design skills, demonstrated in a portfolio of real work.
* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field.
* 4+ years of professional design experience, with significant presentation design experience. Agency experience preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, and strong working knowledge of Keynote and Adobe Creative Suite.
* A strong digital portfolio showing presentation design, visual storytelling, typography, layout, and overall craft, plus examples across other project types.
* Experience designing executive communications, keynotes, or other high-visibility presentations strongly preferred.
* A working style that fits a kind, collaborative, low-drama studio. Culture fit is as important as talent and experience.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Exceptional visual design and typography, with close attention to detail.
* Strong visual storytelling, and the ability to turn complex information into a clear narrative.
* Ability to manage several projects and priorities against tight deadlines.
* Strong verbal and written communication.
* Sound design judgment and creative problem-solving.
* Ability to work collaboratively and take feedback well.
* Comfortable working directly with clients and senior stakeholders in a fast-paced agency.

**Work Environment**

At Electric Pen, you will be part of a creative team that values great work without unnecessary drama. You can expect:

* A remote, collaborative work environment.
* High-impact projects across a variety of industries, with presentation work as a core part of the load.
* A culture that values collaboration, craft, kindness, and thoughtful problem-solving.
* Purpose-driven work that makes a difference for clients, and for your craft.
* Frequent virtual client meetings.
* About 40 hours a week, with occasional extended hours or weekend work when a client deadline requires it.
* Typical hours of about 8:30 or 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Pacific, Monday through Friday.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Competitive salary based on experience.
* Health insurance.
* Paid time off and paid holidays.
* SIMPLE IRA with company match.
* Remote work.

Please submit your resume, a thoughtful cover letter, and a digital portfolio. The portfolio must include your strongest presentation work. A digital portfolio is required.

We want to see how you think, collaborate, and solve problems, not only what you have made. Show us how your experience and approach align with Electric Pen’s work and values. Personality and purpose both belong in the application.

**About Electric Pen**

Electric Pen is a creative agency that delivers dramatic results without the drama. We believe design should solve real business problems, and that people should always come first. We help ambitious companies build meaningful brands through a thoughtful balance of art and strategy.

Electric Pen is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds.

title: Quality Systems & Positive Release Manager
description:
**QUALITY SYSTEMS & POSITIVE RELEASE MANAGER**

**COMPANY SUMMARY (“Who are we?”)**

At The Honest Kitchen, we believe pets deserve the same quality of food as the humans who love them. As pioneers of human grade pet food, we use thoughtfully sourced ingredients and gentle preparation methods to create foods that are as wholesome as they are nutritious. We’re a purpose-driven, growth-minded, proud B Corp, (which is a legal corporate structure that allows us to operate and make decisions based upon a triple bottom line, factoring in social and environmental impacts right alongside our prioritization of long-term financial sustainability!) company made up of people who care deeply about pets, their parents, and each other. We strive for an inclusive work culture that supports a diverse array of skills, experiences, and perspectives our employees bring to the table. For us, differences are a source of strength. We celebrate strong performance and ethical processes, and we work hard every day to nurture an inclusive culture where all employees can innovate and thrive. Here, you will not only build your career, but you will also uncover new experiences and collaborate with passionate colleagues.

The Honest Kitchen values a diverse workforce. Everyone, including women, people of color, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQIA+ community are strongly encouraged to apply. The Honest Kitchen believes that an equitable and inclusive work environment and a diverse, empowered team are key to achieving our mission. We’re looking for candidates who can expand our business culture by bringing their whole, authentic selves to work. We strive to provide all qualified candidates with an equitable and accessible recruitment process.

**POSITION SUMMARY (“What are we looking for?”)**

The Quality Systems & Positive Release Manager owns The Honest Kitchen’s quality management system (QMS) and positive release program across THM and all co-manufacturers. The role is responsible for Systems Development, Document Management, Quality Alerts & Traceability, and the Positive Release Program.

Vendor-facing programs (supplier approval, COA review, material specifications, NCRs and SCARs) sit with the Vendor QA Technologist at THM. This role partners closely with that position so that specifications, testing requirements and release decisions stay aligned.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Systems Development**

* Design, build and continuously improve THK’s QMS so it is scalable, audit-ready and consistent across THM and co-manufacturers.
* Responsible for the QMS framework: quality policy, quality manual, program owners and procedure hierarchy (policies, SOPs, work instructions, forms).
* Manage deviation, CAPA and change control processes, including tracking, effectiveness checks and trending.
* Maintain the internal audit program against SQF and FSMA requirements, and track findings to closure.
* Maintain the quality training matrix and records, and confirm training is completed when procedures change.
* Lead quality systems technology (Smartsheet, SafeFood360, SharePoint, AI tools) to automate workflows, reduce manual work and improve turnaround.
* Build and maintain QMS metrics and dashboards for leadership reviews.

**Document Management**

* Manage THK’s document control process: creation, review, approval, issuance, revision, obsolescence and archival of all controlled documents.
* Maintain the master document list and specification index, with version control and a 12-month review cycle.
* Ensure all documents meet SQF, FSMA and customer requirements and are accessible for audits and inspections.
* Manage record retention and archival in line with regulatory and SQF requirements.
* Coordinate document updates driven by new products, process changes, audits and CAPAs.

**Quality Alerts & Traceability**

* Own the quality alert process: issue, communicate and track quality alerts and hold notifications across THM, co-manufacturers and 3PL warehouses.
* Maintain the hold log and drive timely disposition (release, rework or destruction) with documented approvals.
* Lead mock recall and traceability exercises at THM and each co-manufacturer at least annually, and close gaps found.
* Maintain one-up/one-down lot traceability records from raw ingredient to finished product and customer.
* Support recall execution, market withdrawals and product disposition with the Directors and Regulatory.

**Positive Release Program**

* Manage positive release of finished products and, where required, raw ingredients, by ensuring that:
  + Required testing is complete and results conform to specifications.
  + Production and release documentation is complete and reviewed.
  + Plant and warehouse personnel are notified of hold or release status.
* Maintain the rolling testing schedule and testing requirements by product, and manage third-party laboratory relationships and data.
* Review laboratory protocols, reports and investigations, and lead out-of-specification (OOS) investigations with corrective actions.
* Trend release and testing data (cycle time, OOS rate, on-time release) and communicate results to internal teams and co-manufacturers.
* Partner with R&D to set release programs and validate guaranteed analysis for new and renovated products before commercialization.

**Other**

* Support SQF, regulatory and customer audits with QMS, document and release records.
* Perform other duties as required to support the Quality team or internal stakeholders.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* 95% or more of conforming lots released within 10 days (excluding products with extended test times)
* OOS investigations opened within 2 business days and closed on time
* 100% of controlled documents reviewed within the last 12 months
* Annual mock recall at THM and each co-manufacturer, with 100% of product reconciled within the target time
* 100% of holds dispositioned and documented within target timeframes
* 90% or more of CAPAs and internal audit findings closed on time

**REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES**

* Excellent attention to detail and organization.
* Systems thinker, able to design simple, scalable processes.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Sound independent judgment on hold and release decisions.
* Strong communication with co-manufacturers, labs and internal teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, SharePoint, Smartsheet and quality management systems (e.g., SafeFood360).
* Must love animals and be passionate about their health.

**REQUIRED EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Microbiology, Animal Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of quality assurance experience, including quality systems or document control, with pet food industry experience strongly preferred.
* SQF Practitioner and PCQI preferred.
* Understanding of GMPs, HACCP and FSMA Preventive Controls.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

* Travel up to 30%.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* This role is performed mainly in an office or remote environment.
* Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% or more of the time.
* Must be able to operate a computer and other office machinery, such as a calculator, copier, and printer.
* Must be able to communicate information and ideas so others will understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information.
* Must be able to observe details at close range and for long periods.
* Must be able to move around various buildings/plants when visiting sites.
* Occasionally move items that weigh up to 20 pounds.

The salary range for this role is: $85,000 - $90,000/year

We offer a competitive compensation package, including salary and robust employee benefits. Some key highlights include:

title: Director, Project Controls, AMERS
description:
**Position Overview**  
  
Nscale is building the infrastructure that powers AI. Our North American Data Center Infrastructure (DCI) group is delivering a pipeline of large-scale, high-density data center campuses where speed to power and speed to customer handover decide commercial success. Reliable, well-run scheduling is how we plan that speed and protect it.  
  
The Director, Project Controls – Scheduling leads schedule management across the DCI North America portfolio. This leader owns the scheduling function — its people, standards, and systems — and is accountable for a credible, integrated view of time across every campus, from site selection and utility power through procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover. They give executives and customers a single, trusted answer to the question "when will it be ready, and what could stop it?"  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* **Scheduling leadership:** Build, lead, and develop the North American scheduling team, including Project Controls – Scheduling leads, Schedulers, and Planners; set hiring plans, structure, and career paths.
* **Portfolio master schedule:** Own the DCI portfolio-level schedule that rolls up every project's Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), showing key milestones, interdependencies, shared resources, and capacity delivery dates across all campuses.
* **Scheduling standards:** Establish and enforce DCI scheduling standards — WBS, activity coding, calendars, level-of-detail requirements, baselining, update cadence, and templates — so every project schedule is consistent and comparable.
* **Schedule quality and assurance:** Set schedule health metrics (e.g., DCMA 14-point), run regular schedule reviews, and challenge project and contractor schedules for logic, realism, and completeness.
* **Critical path and milestones:** Maintain clear visibility of portfolio and project critical paths, including utility interconnection and energization, long-lead equipment, permitting, and customer handover commitments; escalate threats early.
* **Schedule risk analysis:** Lead quantitative schedule risk analysis (Monte Carlo / QSRA), set schedule contingency strategy, and provide confidence levels (P50 / P80) for key delivery dates.
* **Contractor schedule management:** Define contractual scheduling requirements for EPC, design-build, and trade contracts; oversee review and acceptance of contractor baselines and updates; and lead delay, time impact, and recovery analysis.
* **Executive reporting:** Own monthly and quarterly schedule reporting to DCI leadership, the executive committee, and customer-facing teams, including milestone forecasts, trends, and recommended actions.
* **Scheduling systems:** Select, implement, and continuously improve scheduling and schedule analytics platforms (e.g., Primavera P6 EPPM, schedule risk and quality tools, and dashboards), and integrate them with cost and project controls reporting.
* **Cross-functional partnership:** Work closely with Project Directors, Construction, Engineering, Procurement, Commissioning, Cost Management, and Commercial teams so schedule, cost, and contract positions stay aligned.

**Qualifications**  
  
**Required**

* 15+ years of planning and scheduling experience on large capital projects, with at least 5 years leading scheduling or project controls teams.
* Experience scheduling mission-critical or complex facilities — data centers, power generation, substations, semiconductor, or comparable industrial builds — valued at $500M+.
* Expert-level CPM scheduling knowledge and hands-on mastery of Primavera P6, including multi-project and enterprise environments.
* Proven experience with quantitative schedule risk analysis, schedule quality assessment, and delay / time impact analysis.
* Track record of setting up scheduling standards, governance, and reporting from the ground up in a fast-growing organization.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to explain complex schedule positions clearly to senior and non-technical audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Hyperscale or colocation data center program experience, including multi-site and phased campus delivery and integrated commissioning (L1–L5).
* AACE PSP or PMI-SP certification; AACE CCP or PMP a plus.
* Owner-side scheduling leadership on EPC, CM-at-risk, and design-build contracts.
* Experience with forensic schedule analysis and claims support.
* Experience implementing Primavera P6 EPPM, schedule analytics tools, or Power BI schedule dashboards at enterprise scale.

**Character & Conduct**

What We Value Most: Character & Conduct  
  
Technical skills can be taught. Character cannot. At Nscale, we're looking for people who show up with integrity, treat others with respect, and take genuine ownership of their work. As a senior leader on the program, this individual also sets the tone for every direct report and site team they oversee. The following traits matter as much to us as any credential or years of experience:

* Integrity — does the right thing even when no one is watching; never misrepresents status, costs, or progress to protect themselves or their team
* Ownership mentality — treats the program as their own and holds themselves and their direct reports accountable without being told
* Respectful under pressure — stays composed and professional with contractors, trades, direct reports, and internal Nscale teams regardless of the circumstances
* Transparent communicator — surfaces problems early and honestly, never buries bad news, and expects the same from the teams they lead
* Team-first attitude — ego stays at the gate; the program and the people on it come first
* Reliable and consistent — shows up prepared, follows through on commitments, and does what they say they will do

We actively seek references that speak to a candidate's character, not just their technical output.

**Tools & Software**

* Primavera P6 EPPM (expert level, required)
* Schedule quality and analysis tools (e.g., Acumen Fuse, Schedule Analyzer)
* Schedule risk analysis tools (e.g., Safran Risk, Primavera Risk Analysis, Acumen Risk)
* Microsoft Project (working knowledge)
* Power BI or similar reporting / dashboard tools
* Microsoft Excel and the Microsoft 365 suite

**Work Environment & Schedule**

* Hybrid role based in North America, with regular travel (approximately 25–40%) to active DCI project sites, contractor offices, and Nscale locations.
* Fast-paced, high-growth environment with multiple concurrent projects; occasional work outside standard hours to support executive reporting cycles and critical project milestones.
* Site visits require adherence to all Nscale and contractor safety programs and use of appropriate PPE.

Job Summary

The OT/ICS Cybersecurity & Controls Engineer III reports to the Director, EMS Engineering and Delivery and is responsible for securing, hardening, and maintaining the industrial network and control system environments that support Prevalon Energy's insightOS™ Container Management System (CMS) and utility-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) deployments. As a senior individual contributor, this engineer owns the cybersecurity posture of OT networks in the field and in the cloud - designing and maintaining segmented network architectures, configuring and troubleshooting managed switches and firewalls, deploying and tuning SIEM tooling, and administering the Ignition SCADA/HMI platform - while advising on architecture, risk, and strategy across the fleet. The role partners closely with Controls, Software, and IT leadership to ensure BESS sites meet applicable cybersecurity compliance requirements (e.g., NERC CIP, IEC 62443, NIST 800-82) while supporting commissioning, incident response, and ongoing operations across the fleet.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

* Design, configure, and maintain OT network architecture for BESS sites, including managed Layer 2/3 switches, VLAN segmentation, subnetting, and routing between control, SCADA, and enterprise zones.
* undefined
Configure, harden, and troubleshoot firewalls (policies, ACLs, NAT, and site-to-site/remote access VPNs) to enforce network segmentation and zero-trust principles across industrial control networks.  

Administer the Ignition SCADA/HMI platform, including Gateway configuration, tag structures, alarming, security zones/roles, and scripting (Python/Jython) to support monitoring and supervisory control of BESS assets.  



* Deploy, tune, and monitor SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel) to aggregate logs, build detections/dashboards, and identify anomalous activity across OT and IT-adjacent systems.
* undefined
Design and maintain Azure cloud network and security architecture supporting cloud-connected CMS/SCADA applications, including virtual networks, network security groups, Azure Firewall, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud.  

* Administer identity and access management (Azure Entra ID) for OT/ICS system access, including role-based access control, conditional access, and privileged access reviews.
* Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments, vulnerability scanning, and gap analyses for ICS/OT assets, and drive remediation in accordance with IEC 62443, NERC CIP, and NIST 800-82/800-53 frameworks.
* undefined
Support cybersecurity compliance audits by maintaining system inventories, network diagrams, security control documentation, and evidence of compliance.  

Develop, maintain, and exercise OT incident response and disaster recovery playbooks/procedures in coordination with IT Security and Operations.  

Partner with Controls Engineering on secure integration of PLCNext controllers, Modbus TCP/RTU, and OPC-UA communications into the CMS network architecture.  

Provide onsite and remote support for network and cybersecurity-related troubleshooting during commissioning, ensuring switches, firewalls, and SCADA/Ignition systems are properly configured prior to energization.

The divisional digital platforms (websites, social, digital screens, advertisements, experiential tools) directly influence the enrollment of approximately 5,000 new students annually and provide financial aid information and services to more than 12,000 students.

  

The Director, Digital Experience and Strategy leads and manages all digital projects focused on relationship building between RIT and the prospective student marketplace by aligning digital architecture, content, and experiences with the strategic needs of the prospective student market for admissions, and the prospect and current student market for financial aid. On a day-to-day basis, this position oversees the strategic development and maintenance of digital content and user experiences aimed at making relationship-building simple, experiential, informative, and highly effective. title: Education Specialist
description:
**REPORTS TO:** Senior Project Manager

**BACKGROUND:**

USI is a national nonprofit with extensive experience in the design and implementation of place-based human capital development strategies in

communities that are undergoing comprehensive physical revitalization.

Founded in 1978, USI is a leader in community development, supporting over 30,000 economically stressed families, approximately 100,000 individuals, in 53 communities in 28 major metropolitan areas. USI represents a movement towards a future where all children and families will be stable and thriving, supported by our unwavering dedication to being results-based, data-driven, and equity-centered.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Education Specialist will provide oversight and implementation of selected initiatives and activities related to education with the Choice Neighborhoods Implementation (CNI) Grant for the transformation of the Murchison neighborhood. This includes all education strategies across the continuum from early childhood to adult education. Each education strategy may consist of multiple programs and activities designed to direct new and innovative Human Capital building programs into distressed urban core neighborhoods and to improve the ability of low-income residents to become more self-sufficient. Specific job duties will include:

* Create a Results Count Annual Action Plan that is informed by data and used to serve as the road map for local education planning and work coordination.
* Develop and submit weekly work plans for accountability.
* Build partnerships based on data, create and implement education tactics designed to advance Urban Strategies national education strategies, performance measures and indicators.
* Provide regular reports as assigned to ensure HUD and Urban Strategies reporting compliance.
* Identify and track targeted children 0-18 and adults, include them in LEARN and other tracking systems to monitor their educational progress.
* Collect a FERPA on each child enrolled in Case Management that will be effective for the duration of the CNI grant period.
* Work with the National Education Director to develop and execute a Data Sharing agreement with the local School District to ensure Urban Strategies’ collect, track, and report on aggregated data about targeted families. Serve as point of contact for the school district.
* Serve as an expert on the needs of target children and families to inform the development grant applications and special initiatives.
* Build successful educational partnerships, track leverage and regularly convene partners to share data, learn about partner’s work, align resources and contributions, and collaborate on special initiatives, as appropriate.
* Develop and maintain an updated Educational Resource Portfolio (electronic and hard copy) separated out by services for youth and adults that can be used by Case Managers and families.
* Represent Urban Strategies at local meetings, take notes and write up reports to share learning and points of connection.
* Troubleshoot education related matters as needed.
* Meet regularly with Case Managers to ensure that all job-related duties are aligned and provide coaching as needed.
* Work with parents or guardians to ensure that children and youth enroll in and have a full access to opportunities to succeed in school. This includes providing referrals and tracking service connections.
* Secure information about school choice opportunities, make it readily available, and assist families in navigating the various options so that parents and guardians can make informed decisions about what is best for their child (ren).
* Research educational best practices and programs for adaption or implementation into communities served by Urban Strategies.
* Ensure the education data integrity within LEARN and facilitate the documentation of stories to support outcomes.
* Actively participate in national education webinars/calls and other training opportunities.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in human services or other relevant field and at least three years of work experience demonstrating the ability to manage all aspects of a project AND at least two years of experience administering complex contracts or grants
* A passion for community building and ability to share that enthusiasm with residents, staff and the larger community
* Ability to draw conclusions and make decisions based on research data and findings.
* Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
* Skilled in writing reports
* Strong organizational skills
* Experience with case management and service coordination
* Skilled in building and maintaining good relationships while managing key contacts
* Ability to analyze and synthesize large amounts of detailed information and communicate key points in a concise manner
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office programs including MS Word, Excel, Power Point and desktop publishing software; proficiency is SPSS or other data analysis software is a plus
* Strong interest in social entrepreneurship
* Ability to function as part of a cross-disciplinary team
* Ability to hold privileged information in a professional and confidential manner
* Flexibility to attend evening and weekend functions and to travel occasionally as required
* Knowledge of the community and area at which the position serves

**Strategic Planning & Roadmap**

* Provide innovation within the cybersecurity realm.

**SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

**Required**

* 10-12+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with 3-5 years in a leadership or program management role.

* Thorough knowledge of professional management practices including supervisory techniques, leadership principles, and employment practices.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including public speaking and the ability to convey complex cybersecurity concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

* Ability to think and communicate strategically about the role of cybersecurity in a global organization.

* Ability to quickly assess an organization's capability-maturity level and apply that knowledge to RFPs, audits, contract reviews, and internal operations.

* Proficiency in at least one major EGRC/ITGRC platform (e.g., ServiceNow GRC, Archer, OneTrust, LogicGate).

* Comprehensive understanding of major cybersecurity frameworks: NIST CSF, CIS Controls, SOC2T2, and COBIT.

* Familiarity with common regulatory schemes including GDPR, PCI-DSS, GLBA, FISMA, HIPAA, and ITAR.

* Advanced understanding of technical controls, how they address risk, and how they map to framework and regulatory requirements.

* Broad understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, common network services, and foundational infrastructure concepts.

* Familiarity with common cybersecurity monitoring technologies: SIEM, IDS, log management, and vulnerability assessment.

description:
Description:

**Behind every successful product is a team united by purpose.**

**About Bender**

For over 80 years, Bender has been a market leader in providing electrical safety equipment to industries worldwide. Our wide portfolio of cutting-edge products ensures that people, equipment, and facilities worldwide are protected with the latest in electrical safety technology. Our worldwide network of over 70 offices, representatives, and partners offers comprehensive product, application, and technical support.

Bender's core competence is electrical safety. With expertise in virtually every industry, Bender provides both the products and knowledge to meet the demands for customer-specific solutions. Always on the cutting edge, our portfolio of electrical safety solutions focuses on a wide range of industries, from mainstay industries such as hospitals, mining, and manufacturing to newly developed industries such as solar, wind, and electric vehicles. Our ongoing research and development in virtually all industries ensures that no matter the application, you can count on Bender to be your partner in electrical safety.

**Benefits**

At Bender Inc., we take care of our people. We know that great benefits make a difference, so we cover 100% of Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance premiums for eligible employees and their families. We also offer:

* Medical Coverage: Choose between a fully covered HDHP with H.S.A or a Buy-Up Plan, both paired with an HRA.
* Dental and Vision Insurance
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
* Health Care and Dependent Care Spending Account (FSA)
* Life Insurance (with optional upgrades)
* 401(k) Plan with 3% Safe Harbor Contribution
* Employee Assistance Program
* Generous PTO, Vacation and 12 paid Holidays
* Paid Maternity/Parental Leave
* Flexible Work Schedules **\*potential hybrid for local candidates only\***

**Main Duties and Responsibilities:** The Business Unit Director provides overall leadership, strategy, and performance management for the healthcare business unit. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth, optimizing operations, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction, all while aligning with the company’s strategic goals.

**Strategic Leadership:**

* Develop and execute the business unit’s strategic plan in alignment with company objectives, ensuring sustainable growth and profitability.
* Identify and capitalize on growth opportunities, market trends, and competitive insights to drive business success.
* Collaborate with senior leadership to define and track key performance indicators (KPIs), ensuring the achievement of strategic goals.
* Oversee and optimize sub-functions within the business unit to maximize organizational impact.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to enhance productivity, quality, and cost-effectiveness while maintaining a competitive market position.
* Partner with the VP of Sales to design and execute high-impact strategic initiatives that drive revenue and market expansion.

**Financial and Operational Management:**

* Oversee P&L for the business unit, ensuring financial targets are consistently met or exceeded.
* Develop and manage annual budgets and forecasts, optimizing resource allocation for maximum efficiency.
* Implement cost control measures and operational improvements to maximize profitability and long-term sustainability.
* Conduct competitive analysis to evaluate market competition by comparing the company’s product offerings to those of competitors.

**Sales and Business Development:**

* Drive revenue growth by identifying and capitalizing on new business opportunities.
* Develop and lead sales and marketing strategies to expand market share and customer base.
* Works closely with the sales team to develop product sales strategies that enhance market share and drive business growth.

**Team Leadership and Development:**

* Mentor and develop talent, ensuring succession planning and professional growth.
* Establish clear goals, performance metrics, and accountability standards for team members.
* Promote cross-departmental collaboration to improve efficiency and drive innovation.
* Provides strategic guidance and leadership to subordinates, ensuring alignment with business goals and company values.

**Customer and Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Ensure exceptional customer satisfaction through high-quality service delivery and proactive engagement.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders to enhance business opportunities.
* Serve as a key liaison between internal teams and external partners.
* Address client concerns and ensure timely resolution of issues.

**Process Improvement and Innovation:**

* Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and implement best practices.
* Support digital transformation initiatives and leverage data-driven decision-making to enhance business performance.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the business unit.

**Other Duties**

* Prepare and submit reports and performance metrics as required by senior leadership.
* Assists in developing and maintaining processes, procedures, and supporting documentation for cross-functional departments.
* Stay current with industry trends and best practices by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.
* Serve as a backup for creating and maintaining project quotations, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
* Provide expert-level technical, application, and installation support for products.

Requirements:

**Educational and Experience Requirements**

* 4-year engineering degree from accredited university (BSEE preferred)
* 10+ years’ experience in progressive leadership, sales, product management, or business development providing Engineered to Order technical equipment and/or services (non-commodity) into critical infrastructure segments ((preferred: healthcare segment (Hospitals, Ambulatory Surgery Center, etc.)).
* Experience selling/providing product to the USA, Latin America, and Canada
* Familiarity with functional application of low voltage electrical distribution equipment according to country requirements - must be able to read/understand electrical schematic drawings, panel schedules, and specifications.
* Deep knowledge of application and product regulatory requirements including but not limited to National Electrical Code (NEC), NFPA 99, UL, CSA.
* 5+ yrs knowledge and experience with ERP system Sales and Material management modules (SAP preferred)
* 5+ yrs knowledge and experience with CRM (Salesforce preferred)
* Familiarity with electrical safety equipment for personnel protection – preferred

**Other Requirements**

* Strong business acumen, strategic thinking and leadership capabilities.
* A driven track record of achieving financial and operational targets.
* Familiarity with digitalization, automation, and data analytics.
* In-depth understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements within the industry.
* Highly efficient in detail-oriented tasks, with the ability to multitask and meet deadlines.
* Demonstrates proficiency in concepts, practices, and procedures across multiple disciplines.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills to collaborate effectively with senior executives across various functions and geographies
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.
* High integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism
* Self-motivated with a high-energy, results-driven approach.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Eager to learn and adapt to new challenges and opportunities.
* Ability to work both independently and with a team
* Ability to travel up to 30-40% as required.

**Physical & Cognitive Demands**

* Sitting for extended periods of time, some walking and standing
* Frequent operation and use of computer
* Occasional lifting and moving of 10-45 pounds
* Occasional stooping, bending, crouching, reaching or crawling
* Position requires manual dexterity and the ability to use hands/fingers, touch and feel
* Must be able to talk, see, hear and write
* Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus
* Incumbent must have the ability to count accurately, add, subtract, multiply, divide and record, balance and check results for accuracy.

They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Essential job functions must be performed with or without accommodation, and employees who require assistance may request reasonable accommodations under the ADA. Additionally, all employees must adhere to Bender Inc. Safety Policies and Procedures and safety requirements set by our customers where applicable.*

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

title: Senior Project Manager (Social and Human Services Exp.)
description:
**REPORTS TO:** Regional Vice President

**LOCATION:** Fayetteville, NC

**STATUS:** Full Time (Exempt)

**BACKGROUND:**

USI is a national nonprofit with extensive experience in the design and implementation of place-based human capital development strategies in communities that are undergoing comprehensive physical revitalization.

Founded in 1978, USI is a leader in community development, supporting about 30,000 economically stressed families, approximately 100,000 individuals, in 53 communities in 28 major metropolitan areas. USI represents a movement towards a future where all children and families will be stable and thriving, supported by our unwavering dedication to being results-based, data-driven, and equity-centered.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Senior Project Manager will plan and direct all aspects of the People Implementation Strategy of the City of Fayetteville and Fayetteville Metropolitan Housing Authority’s Choice Neighborhoods Implementation (CNI) Grant from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development. The Senior Project Manager will establish effective and strong working relationships with clients and other key community partners (i.e. schools, service providers, civic leaders, federal, state and local public agencies, businesses, philanthropy, etc.).

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Partnership Development and Cultivation**

* Research and identify high impact partners that have the ability or with capacity building will have the ability to meet the programmatic goals of the CNI Grant.
* Oversee, monitor and lead sub-contractors and partners from the private, nonprofit and public sectors and support them in implementation of programs and services in furtherance of the CNI Grant.
* Develop and sustain new working relationships with key partner organizations and social service providers with resources that can support programmatic goals of the CNI Grant.
* Coordinate and manage the development of any special projects as needed.
* Collaborate with the housing management team to ensure that housing stability goals for each specific site are being addressed effectively.

**Reporting Requirements**

* In consultation with Executive staff, implement the Transformation Plan for People for the CNI target neighborhood. Programs and services must be informed by ongoing needs assessment and evidence-based practice.
* Track and report CNI programmatic outcomes and engage in ongoing evaluation of programs and services to ensure that they meet project objectives and other project requirements.
* Monitoring the productivity of all data entered into the LEARN Performance Management System to prepare reports and document progress towards programmatic goals.

**Sustainability and Capacity Building**

* Facilitate community building, leadership training and capacity building activities to strengthen and expand the ability of residents, resident leaders and local partners to contribute to neighborhood transformation.
* Support sustainability planning, fundraising and resource development efforts as directed, including through ongoing identification of potential partnerships and funding opportunities, and assisting with writing grant or project proposals.

**Administrative**

* Manage project contracts and budgets and be accountable for expenditures to Director of Finance.
* Develop and present or publish internal and external reports to stakeholders and partners.
* Actively participate in Urban Strategies program meetings and other meetings related to the project.
* Be available to occasionally work nights and/or weekends, and travel.
* Other administrative duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Education and/or experience required:**

* Master's Degree preferred. Bachelor's Degree required.
* Five years of work experience, in the not-for-profit or human services sector, demonstrating progressively higher levels of responsibility for managing all aspects of a project or program, overseeing partnerships and contracts, and supervising a team of individuals.

**Skills and/or competencies required:**

* Excellent communication skills, both oral and written. Must be able to communicate effectively with all members of a diverse stakeholder group, from residents to professionals and executives. Must provide writing sample demonstrating effective persuasive writing.
* Must be comfortable and effective in facilitating group processes.
* Must have ability to set vision, lead, and empower team members, residents and service partners.
* Strong organizational, planning and time management skills.
* Ability to analyze and interpret data, and to base program designs on resident driven and data-driven rationale.
* A strong sense of and respect for confidentiality involving both participants and fellow employees.
* Must excel in fast-paced environment with multiple service locations and a broad set of diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a variety of settings with culturally diverse people and communities with the ability to be culturally sensitive and appropriate.
* Passion for community building and ability to share that enthusiasm with residents, staff and the larger community.
* The ability to work independently and with initiative, combined with skills for thriving in a team environment to achieve shared goals.
* The ability to develop and balance a program/project budget.
* Computer proficiency in MS Office Suite (Advanced MS Excel), other commonly used software.
